                return next_url

    # 3) numeric pagination: find current page and go to next sibling
    try:
        current_number = None
        for li in soup.select("ul.pagination li, .pagination li, nav[aria-label*='Sayfalandırma'] li"):
            if "active" in (li.get("class") or []):
                try:
                    current_number = int(li.get_text(strip=True))
                except Exception:
                    continue
        if current_number is not None:
            for a in soup.select("ul.pagination a, .pagination a"):
                try:
                    if int(a.get_text(strip=True)) == current_number + 1:
                        href = a.get("href")
                        next_url = absolute_url(base_url, href) if href else None
                        if next_url and next_url != current_url:
                            return next_url
                except Exception:
                    continue
    except Exception:
        pass

    return None


def extract_product_links(base_url: str, soup: BeautifulSoup) -> Set[str]:
    """Extract product detail page links from a category/listing page."""
    selectors = [
        ".product-list a",
        ".products a",
        ".product-grid a",
        ".product-item a",
        ".product-card a",
        "article a",
        "a.product",
        "a.product-link",
        "a[href*='urun']",
        "a[href*='product']",
        "a[href*='/p/']",
        "a[href*='/detail']",
    ]
    links: Set[str] = set()
    for sel in selectors:
        for a in soup.select(sel):
            href = a.get("href")
            absu = absolute_url(base_url, href) if href else None
            if not absu or not same_domain(base_url, absu):
                continue
            # Filter out category/list pages heuristically by checking hint pattern and excluding obvious non-product paths
            if PRODUCT_LINK_HINT.search(absu):
                links.add(absu)
    # Fallback: all anchors with hint
    if not links:
        for a in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
            absu = absolute_url(base_url, a["href"])
            if absu and same_domain(base_url, absu) and PRODUCT_LINK_HINT.search(absu):
                links.add(absu)
    return links


def extract_breadcrumbs(soup: BeautifulSoup) -> List[str]:
    """Extract breadcrumb text as a list."""
    crumbs: List[str] = []
    # Common breadcrumb selectors
    for sel in [".breadcrumb a", "nav.breadcrumb a", "ol.breadcrumb li", "nav[aria-label='breadcrumb'] a"]:
        els = soup.select(sel)
        if els:
            for el in els:
                txt = clean_text(el.get_text(" ", strip=True))
                if txt:
                    crumbs.append(txt)
            break
    # Fallback meta breadcrumbs (rare)
    if not crumbs:
        metas = soup.select("meta[property='article:section'][content]")
        for m in metas:
            crumbs.append(m["content"])
    # De-dup
    out: List[str] = []
    seen: Set[str] = set()
    for c in crumbs:
        if c not in seen:
            seen.add(c)
            out.append(c)
    return out


def parse_product_page(base_url: str, url: str, html: str) -> Product:
    """Parse a product detail page and return a Product dataclass."""
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

    # Try JSON-LD first
    ld = parse_jsonld_product(soup, base_url)

    # Name
    name = ld.get("name") if ld else None
    if not name:
        name = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "h1[itemprop='name']",
            "h1.product-title",
            ".product-title",
            ".product-name",
            "h1",
        ])

    # Price
    raw_price = ld.get("raw_price") if ld else None
    price_currency = ld.get("price_currency") if ld else None
    if not raw_price:
        raw_price = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "meta[itemprop='price']",
            "span[itemprop='price']",
            ".price .amount",
            ".product-price .amount",
            ".product-price",
            ".price",
        ])
        # If meta provides numeric price, we still parse for float
    price_val, detected_curr = parse_price(raw_price)
    if not price_currency:
        price_currency = detected_curr

    # Availability
    availability = ld.get("availability") if ld else None
    if not availability:
        availability_txt = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "[itemprop='availability']",
            ".availability",
            ".stock",
            ".product-stock-status",
        ])
        if availability_txt:
            availability = availability_txt
        # Normalize Turkish common words
        if availability:
            t = availability.lower()
            if "stok" in t and ("var" in t or "mevcut" in t):
                availability = "InStock"
            elif "yok" in t or "tükendi" in t or "tukendi" in t:
                availability = "OutOfStock"

    # SKU
    sku = ld.get("sku") if ld else None
    if not sku:
        sku = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "[itemprop='sku']",
            ".sku",
            ".product-sku",
        ])

    # Brand
    brand = ld.get("brand") if ld else None
    if not brand:
        brand = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "[itemprop='brand']",
            ".brand",
            ".product-brand",
        ])

    # GTIN
    gtin = ld.get("gtin") if ld else None
    if not gtin:
        gtin = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "meta[itemprop='gtin13']",
            "meta[itemprop='gtin12']",
            "[itemprop='gtin13']",
            "[itemprop='gtin12']",
        ])

    # Description
    description = ld.get("description") if ld else None
    if not description:
        description = extract_first_match(soup, [
            "[itemprop='description']",
            "#tab-description",
            "#description",
            ".product-description",
            ".description",
        ])

    # Images
    image_urls = ld.get("image_urls") if ld and "image_urls" in ld else None
    if not image_urls:
        image_urls = extract_all_image_urls(soup, [
            "meta[property='og:image']",
            "img[itemprop='image']",
            ".product-images img",
            ".product-gallery img",
            ".gallery img",
            ".product img",
            "img",
        ], base_url)
    # Deduplicate while preserving order
    image_urls_unique: List[str] = []
    seen: Set[str] = set()
    for u in image_urls:
        if u and u not in seen:
            seen.add(u)
            image_urls_unique.append(u)

    # Breadcrumbs and category
    breadcrumbs = extract_breadcrumbs(soup)
    category = None
    if breadcrumbs:
        # Heuristic: last or second last crumb may be the category (excluding the product itself/home)
        if name and breadcrumbs and breadcrumbs[-1] == name:
            category = breadcrumbs[-2] if len(breadcrumbs) >= 2 else None
        elif len(breadcrumbs) >= 1:
            category = breadcrumbs[-1]

    product = Product(
        name=name,
        url=url,
        category=category,
        price=price_val,
        price_currency=price_currency,
        raw_price=raw_price,
        availability=availability,
        sku=sku,
        brand=brand,
        gtin=gtin,
        description=description,
        image_urls=image_urls_unique,
        breadcrumbs=breadcrumbs,
        scraped_at=dt.datetime.utcnow().isoformat(timespec="seconds") + "Z",
    )
    return product


def crawl_category(
    session: requests.Session,
    rp: robotparser.RobotFileParser,
    user_agent: str,
    base_url: str,
    start_url: str,
    timeout: float,
    delay_min: float,
    delay_max: float,
    max_pages: int,
    max_products: int,
    seen_products: Set[str],
) -> Tuple[List[Product], Set[str]]:
    """
    Crawl a single category: follow pagination, collect product links, and parse product pages.
    Returns list of products and updated seen_products set.
    """
    products: List[Product] = []
    visited_pages: Set[str] = set()
    to_visit = [start_url]
    pages_crawled = 0

    while to_visit and pages_crawled < max_pages and len(products) < max_products:
        page_url = to_visit.pop(0)
        if page_url in visited_pages:
            continue
        logging.info("Category page: %s", page_url)
        resp = polite_get(session, page_url, rp, user_agent, timeout, delay_min, delay_max)
        visited_pages.add(page_url)
        pages_crawled += 1
        if not resp:
            continue
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

        # Collect product links
        product_links = extract_product_links(base_url, soup)
        logging.info("Found %d product links on page", len(product_links))

        # Visit products
        for purl in product_links:
            if len(products) >= max_products:
                break
            if purl in seen_products:
                continue
            logging.info("Product page: %s", purl)
            presp = polite_get(session, purl, rp, user_agent, timeout, delay_min, delay_max)
            if not presp:
                continue
            try:
                prod = parse_product_page(base_url, purl, presp.text)
                if prod.name:
                    products.append(prod)
                    seen_products.add(purl)
                else:
                    logging.debug("Skipping product without name: %s", purl)
            except Exception as e:
                logging.warning("Failed to parse product %s: %s", purl, e)

        # Discover next page
        next_url = discover_next_page(base_url, soup, page_url)
        if next_url and next_url not in visited_pages:
            to_visit.append(next_url)

    return products, seen_products


def scrape_seval(
    base_url: str,
    csv_path: Path,
    jsonl_path: Path,
    timeout: float = 20.0,
    delay_min: float = 1.0,
    delay_max: float = 2.5,
    max_pages_per_category: int = 30,
    max_products_total: int = 1000,
    log_level: str = "INFO",
) -> None:
    """Main scraping workflow: discover categories, crawl, and persist results."""
    setup_logger(log_level)
    user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; SevalScraper/1.0; +https://example.com/bot) PythonRequests/2.x"
    session = build_session(user_agent)
    rp = build_robot_parser(base_url, user_agent, session, timeout)

    # Fetch homepage
    logging.info("Fetching homepage: %s", base_url)
    home_resp = polite_get(session, base_url, rp, user_agent, timeout, delay_min, delay_max)
    if not home_resp:
        logging.error("Failed to fetch homepage. Exiting.")
        return
    home_soup = BeautifulSoup(home_resp.text, "html.parser")

    # Discover category links for chocolate/candy
    cat_links = find_category_links(base_url, home_soup)
    if not cat_links:
        logging.warning("No category links discovered using keywords. You may provide category URLs manually.")
    else:
        logging.info("Discovered %d category links", len(cat_links))

    # Prepare output writers
    csv_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    jsonl_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    fieldnames = [f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(Product)]
    # Use newline='' for correct CSV writing across platforms
    csv_file = csv_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    jsonl_file = jsonl_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8")

    csv_writer = csv.DictWriter(csv_file, fieldnames=fieldnames)
    csv_writer.writeheader()

    # Crawl each category up to the total product limit
    total_products: int = 0
    seen_products: Set[str] = set()
    all_products: List[Product] = []

    try:
        for cat in cat_links or [base_url]:
            if total_products >= max_products_total:
                break
            logging.info("Crawling category: %s", cat)
            products, seen_products = crawl_category(
                session=session,
                rp=rp,
                user_agent=user_agent,
                base_url=base_url,
                start_url=cat,
                timeout=timeout,
                delay_min=delay_min,
                delay_max=delay_max,
                max_pages=max_pages_per_category,
                max_products=(max_products_total - total_products),
                seen_products=seen_products,
            )
            for p in products:
                row = asdict(p)
                csv_writer.writerow(row)
                jsonl_file.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            all_products.extend(products)
            total_products += len(products)
            logging.info("Category complete: %d products (total so far: %d)", len(products), total_products)
    finally:
        csv_file.close()
        jsonl_file.close()

    logging.info("Scraping complete. Total products: %d", total_products)
    logging.info("CSV saved to: %s", csv_path)
    logging.info("JSONL saved to: %s", jsonl_path)


# -------------- CLI -------------- #

def parse_args(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Scrape product details from Seval Çikolata (chocolate and candy categories)."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", type=str, required=False, default="https://www.sevalcikolata.com.tr",
                        help="Base URL of Seval Çikolata website (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--csv", type=Path, required=False, default=Path("products.csv"),
                        help="Path to output CSV file (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--jsonl", type=Path, required=False, default=Path("products.jsonl"),
                        help="Path to output JSONL file (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=20.0, help="HTTP request timeout in seconds (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--delay-min", type=float, default=1.0, help="Minimum delay between requests in seconds (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--delay-max", type=float, default=2.5, help="Maximum delay between requests in seconds (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--max-pages-per-category", type=int, default=30,
                        help="Maximum number of pages to crawl per category (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--max-products", type=int, default=500,
                        help="Maximum total number of products to scrape (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("--log-level", type=str, default="INFO",
                        choices=["DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR"],
                        help="Logging level (default: %(default)s)")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    if args.delay_max < args.delay_min:
        print("Error: --delay-max must be >= --delay-min", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

    # Basic URL validation
    try:
        parsed = urlparse(args.base_url)
        if not parsed.scheme.startswith("http") or not parsed.netloc:
            raise ValueError("Invalid base URL")
    except Exception:
        print("Error: Invalid --base-url provided.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

    try:
        scrape_seval(
            base_url=args.base_url,
            csv_path=args.csv,
            jsonl_path=args.jsonl,
            timeout=args.timeout,
            delay_min=args.delay_min,
            delay_max=args.delay_max,
            max_pages_per_category=args.max_pages_per_category,
            max_products_total=args.max_products,
            log_level=args.log_level,
        )
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nInterrupted by user. Exiting.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(130)
    except Exception as e:
        logging.exception("Unexpected error: %s", e)
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            # Random drift between -0.5% and +0.5%
            drift_pct = Decimal(str(self._rng.uniform(-0.005, 0.005)))
            new_price = price * (Decimal("1") + drift_pct)
            # Keep price within a reasonable band
            new_price = max(new_price, Decimal("1"))
            new_price = new_price.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_DOWN)
            self._prices[symbol] = new_price
            return new_price

        if new_avail < Decimal("0") - Decimal("1e-9"):
            raise APIRequestError(f"Insufficient balance for {currency}: need delta {delta}, have {bal.available}")
        self._balances[currency] = BalanceInfo(currency=currency, available=new_avail, total=new_avail)

    def _split_symbol(self, symbol: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        if "-" in symbol:
            base, quote = symbol.split("-", 1)
            return base, quote
        # Fallback: assume last 4 chars as quote (e.g., USDT)
        if len(symbol) > 4:
            return symbol[:-4], symbol[-4:]
        raise APIRequestError(f"Unrecognized symbol format: {symbol}")

    def get_position(self, symbol: str) -> Optional[Position]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._positions.get(symbol)

    def place_market_order(self, symbol: str, side: str, quantity: Decimal) -> Order:
        if quantity <= 0:
            raise APIRequestError("Quantity must be positive.")
        side = side.lower()
        if side not in ("buy", "sell"):
            raise APIRequestError("Side must be 'buy' or 'sell'.")

        with self._lock:
            price = self._step_price(symbol)
            base, quote = self._split_symbol(symbol)

            base_ccy = base
            quote_ccy = quote

            # Update balances and position
            cost = (quantity * price).quantize(Decimal("0.00000001"), rounding=ROUND_DOWN)
            if side == "buy":
                # Spend quote, receive base
                self._update_balance(quote_ccy, -cost)
                self._update_balance(base_ccy, quantity)
                pos = self._positions.get(symbol)
                if pos:
                    # New average price = (old_qty*old_price + qty*price) / (old_qty + qty)
                    new_qty = pos.quantity + quantity
                    new_avg = ((pos.quantity * pos.avg_price) + (quantity * price)) / new_qty
                    self._positions[symbol] = Position(symbol=symbol, quantity=new_qty, avg_price=new_avg)
                else:
                    self._positions[symbol] = Position(symbol=symbol, quantity=quantity, avg_price=price)
            else:  # sell
                # Receive quote, give base
                pos = self._positions.get(symbol)
                if not pos or pos.quantity < quantity:
                    raise APIRequestError("Insufficient position to sell.")
                self._update_balance(quote_ccy, cost)
                self._update_balance(base_ccy, -quantity)
                remaining = pos.quantity - quantity
                if remaining <= Decimal("0"):
                    self._positions.pop(symbol, None)
                else:
                    self._positions[symbol] = Position(symbol=symbol, quantity=remaining, avg_price=pos.avg_price)

            order = Order(
                id=str(uuid4()),
                symbol=symbol,
                side=side,
                quantity=quantity,
                price=price,
                status="filled",
                ts=time.time(),
            )
            self._orders.append(order)
            self._status = RobotStatus(running=self._status.running, last_heartbeat_ts=time.time())
            return order

    def list_orders(self, symbol: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 50) -> List[Order]:
        with self._lock:
            result = [o for o in self._orders if (symbol is None or o.symbol == symbol)]
            return list(reversed(result))[:limit]

    def heartbeat(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._status = RobotStatus(running=self._status.running, last_heartbeat_ts=time.time())


# -------------------------------
# Strategy: Moving Average Crossover
# -------------------------------

class MovingAverageCrossoverStrategy:
    """
    Simple moving average crossover strategy:
    - Buy when short MA crosses above long MA
    - Sell when short MA crosses below long MA
    """

    def __init__(self, cfg: StrategyConfig) -> None:
        if cfg.short_window <= 0 or cfg.long_window <= 0:
            raise ConfigurationError("short_window and long_window must be positive.")
        if cfg.short_window >= cfg.long_window:
            raise ConfigurationError("short_window must be smaller than long_window.")
        self.cfg = cfg
        self._short = deque(maxlen=cfg.short_window)
        self._long = deque(maxlen=cfg.long_window)
        self._last_signal: Optional[str] = None  # "buy", "sell", or None

    def update_price(self, price: Decimal) -> None:
        self._short.append(price)
        self._long.append(price)

    def _avg(self, q: deque) -> Optional[Decimal]:
        if not q:
            return None
        return sum(q, Decimal("0")) / Decimal(len(q))

    def get_signal(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Returns:
            "buy", "sell", or None if no actionable signal.
        """
        if len(self._short) < self._short.maxlen or len(self._long) < self._long.maxlen:
            return None
        s = self._avg(self._short)
        l = self._avg(self._long)
        if s is None or l is None:
            return None
        if s > l and self._last_signal != "buy":
            self._last_signal = "buy"
            return "buy"
        if s < l and self._last_signal != "sell":
            self._last_signal = "sell"
            return "sell"
        return None


# -------------------------------
# Trader Orchestrator
# -------------------------------

class Trader:
    """
    Orchestrates the trading loop: retrieves prices, evaluates strategy, manages risk,
    and interacts with the SwiftTrade client to place orders.
    """

    def __init__(self, client: SwiftTradeExpressClient, config: StrategyConfig, logger: logging.Logger) -> None:
        self.client = client
        self.cfg = config
        self.logger = logger
        self.strategy = MovingAverageCrossoverStrategy(config)
        self._stop_event = threading.Event()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop_event.set()

    def _compute_trade_quantity(self, price: Decimal) -> Decimal:
        """
        Compute how much base asset to buy given per-trade budget in quote currency.
        """
        if price <= 0:
            raise SwiftTradeError("Invalid price for quantity calculation.")
        qty = (self.cfg.per_trade_budget / price).quantize(Decimal("0.00000001"), rounding=ROUND_DOWN)
        return qty

    def _position_value_quote(self, position: Optional[Position], price: Decimal) -> Decimal:
        if not position:
            return Decimal("0")
        return (position.quantity * price).quantize(Decimal("0.00000001"), rounding=ROUND_DOWN)

    def _apply_risk_controls(
        self,
        position: Optional[Position],
        price: Decimal
    ) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Check stop-loss and take-profit.
        Returns "sell" if a risk event triggers a sell; otherwise None.
        """
        if not position or position.quantity <= 0:
            return None
        entry = position.avg_price
        if entry <= 0:
            return None
        change = (price - entry) / entry
        if change <= -self.cfg.stop_loss_pct:
            return "sell"
        if change >= self.cfg.take_profit_pct:
            return "sell"
        return None

    def run(self) -> None:
        """
        Main trading loop. Safe to stop via .stop() or SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers.
        """
        try:
            self.client.authenticate()
            status = self.client.get_robot_status()
            if not status.running:
                self.logger.info("Robot not running. Starting robot...")
                status = self.client.start_robot()
            self.logger.info(f"Robot status: running={status.running}")

            self.client.set_robot_params({
                "strategy": "sma_crossover",
                "short_window": str(self.cfg.short_window),
                "long_window": str(self.cfg.long_window),
                "symbol": self.cfg.symbol,
            })
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.exception(f"Startup failed: {e}")
            raise

        next_tick = time.monotonic()
        iteration = 0

        while not self._stop_event.is_set():
            iteration += 1
            try:
                # Heartbeat periodically
                if iteration % 5 == 0:
                    try:
                        self.client.heartbeat()
                    except Exception as hb_err:
                        self.logger.warning(f"Heartbeat failed: {hb_err}")

                # Verify robot is running
                status = self.client.get_robot_status()
                if not status.running:
                    self.logger.warning("Robot is not running. Waiting...")
                    time.sleep(2)
                    continue

                # Fetch price and position
                price = self.client.get_price(self.cfg.symbol)
                self.strategy.update_price(price)
                position = self.client.get_position(self.cfg.symbol)

                # Risk-based exits
                risk_signal = self._apply_risk_controls(position, price)
                if risk_signal == "sell" and position and position.quantity > 0:
                    quantity = position.quantity
                    if not self.cfg.dry_run:
                        order = self.client.place_market_order(self.cfg.symbol, "sell", quantity)
                        self.logger.info(f"Risk exit: sold {quantity} {self.cfg.symbol} at {order.price}")
                    else:
                        self.logger.info(f"[Dry-Run] Risk exit signal. Would sell {quantity} {self.cfg.symbol} at {price}")
                    # Proceed to next cycle
                    next_tick += self.cfg.trade_interval_sec
                    self._sleep_until(next_tick)
                    continue

                # Strategy signals
                signal_action = self.strategy.get_signal()
                if signal_action == "buy":
                    # Enforce max position size
                    qty = self._compute_trade_quantity(price)
                    position_value = self._position_value_quote(position, price)
                    if position_value + (qty * price) <= self.cfg.max_position_quote:
                        if not self.cfg.dry_run:
                            order = self.client.place_market_order(self.cfg.symbol, "buy", qty)
                            self.logger.info(f"Buy executed: {qty} {self.cfg.symbol} at {order.price}")
                        else:
                            self.logger.info(f"[Dry-Run] Buy signal. Would buy {qty} {self.cfg.symbol} at {price}")
                    else:
                        self.logger.info("Buy signal ignored: max position limit would be exceeded.")

                elif signal_action == "sell":
                    # Sell entire position for simplicity
                    if position and position.quantity > 0:
                        qty = position.quantity
                        if not self.cfg.dry_run:
                            order = self.client.place_market_order(self.cfg.symbol, "sell", qty)
                            self.logger.info(f"Sell executed: {qty} {self.cfg.symbol} at {order.price}")
                        else:
                            self.logger.info(f"[Dry-Run] Sell signal. Would sell {qty} {self.cfg.symbol} at {price}")
                    else:
                        self.logger.debug("Sell signal received but no position to sell.")

                # Log balances periodically
                if iteration % 10 == 0:
                    base, quote = self.cfg.base_currency, self.cfg.quote_currency
                    try:
                        bal_quote = self.client.get_balance(quote)
                        bal_base = self.client.get_balance(base)
                        pos = self.client.get_position(self.cfg.symbol)
                        pos_value = self._position_value_quote(pos, price)
                        self.logger.info(
                            f"Balances - {quote}: {bal_quote.available}, {base}: {bal_base.available}; "
                            f"Position value: {pos_value} {quote} at price {price}"
                        )
                    except Exception as be:
                        self.logger.warning(f"Balance fetch failed: {be}")

            except Exception as e:
                # Catch-all for robustness; log and continue
                self.logger.exception(f"Iteration error: {e}")

            # Wait until next tick
            next_tick += self.cfg.trade_interval_sec
            self._sleep_until(next_tick)

        # Graceful shutdown
        try:
            status = self.client.get_robot_status()
            if status.running:
                self.logger.info("Stopping robot on shutdown.")
                self.client.stop_robot()
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.warning(f"Failed to stop robot during shutdown: {e}")

    def _sleep_until(self, target_monotonic: float) -> None:
        now = time.monotonic()
        if target_monotonic > now:
            time.sleep(target_monotonic - now)


# -------------------------------
# Utilities
# -------------------------------

def parse_symbol(symbol: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Parse a symbol string like "BTC-USDT" into ("BTC", "USDT").
    """
    if "-" in symbol:
        base, quote = symbol.split("-", 1)
        return base, quote
    # Fallback: try to split at position where quote is likely 3-5 chars
    for qlen in (5, 4, 3):
        if len(symbol) > qlen:
            return symbol[:-qlen], symbol[-qlen:]
    raise ConfigurationError(f"Unsupported symbol format: {symbol}")


def build_logger(verbosity: int) -> logging.Logger:
    logger = logging.getLogger("swifttrade")
    logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG if verbosity > 1 else logging.INFO)
    ch = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    ch.setLevel(logging.DEBUG if verbosity > 1 else logging.INFO)
    formatter = logging.Formatter(
        fmt="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
        datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    )
    ch.setFormatter(formatter)
    if not logger.handlers:
        logger.addHandler(ch)
    return logger


def load_decimal_env(name: str, default: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    val = os.getenv(name)
    if val is None or val.strip() == "":
        return default
    return Decimal(val)


# -------------------------------
# Main Entrypoint
# -------------------------------

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SwiftTrade Express - Crypto Investment Automation")
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", type=str, default=os.getenv("SWIFTTRADE_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080"),
                        help="SwiftTrade Express API base URL (for real client).")
    parser.add_argument("--api-key", type=str, default=os.getenv("SWIFTTRADE_API_KEY", ""),
                        help="API key for SwiftTrade Express.")
    parser.add_argument("--api-secret", type=str, default=os.getenv("SWIFTTRADE_API_SECRET", ""),
                        help="API secret for SwiftTrade Express.")
    parser.add_argument("--symbol", type=str, default=os.getenv("SYMBOL", "BTC-USDT"),
                        help="Trading symbol, e.g., BTC-USDT")
    parser.add_argument("--short-window", type=int, default=int(os.getenv("SHORT_WINDOW", "5")),
                        help="Short moving average window.")
    parser.add_argument("--long-window", type=int, default=int(os.getenv("LONG_WINDOW", "20")),
                        help="Long moving average window.")
    parser.add_argument("--interval", type=int, default=int(os.getenv("INTERVAL_SEC", "30")),
                        help="Seconds between strategy evaluations.")
    parser.add_argument("--budget", type=str, default=os.getenv("PER_TRADE_BUDGET", "25"),
                        help="Per-trade budget in quote currency (string for precision).")
    parser.add_argument("--max-position", type=str, default=os.getenv("MAX_POSITION_QUOTE", "500"),
                        help="Maximum allowed position size in quote currency.")
    parser.add_argument("--stop-loss-pct", type=str, default=os.getenv("STOP_LOSS_PCT", "0.10"),
                        help="Stop loss percent as decimal, e.g., 0.10 for 10%.")
    parser.add_argument("--take-profit-pct", type=str, default=os.getenv("TAKE_PROFIT_PCT", "0.20"),
                        help="Take profit percent as decimal, e.g., 0.20 for 20%.")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Do not place live orders.")
    parser.add_argument("--use-mock", action="store_true", help="Use mock client (no network).")
    parser.add_argument("--verbosity", type=int, default=int(os.getenv("VERBOSITY", "1")),
                        help="Logging verbosity: 0=info, 1=info, 2=debug")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    logger = build_logger(args.verbosity)

    # Prepare strategy configuration
    base_ccy, quote_ccy = parse_symbol(args.symbol)
    cfg = StrategyConfig(
        symbol=args.symbol,
        base_currency=base_ccy,
        quote_currency=quote_ccy,
        short_window=args.short_window,
        long_window=args.long_window,
        trade_interval_sec=args.interval,
        per_trade_budget=Decimal(args.budget),
        max_position_quote=Decimal(args.max_position),
        stop_loss_pct=Decimal(args.stop_loss_pct),
        take_profit_pct=Decimal(args.take_profit_pct),
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )

    # Instantiate client
    if args.use_mock:
        client: SwiftTradeExpressClient = MockSwiftTradeExpressClient()
        logger.info("Using MockSwiftTradeExpressClient (paper trading).")
    else:
        client = RealSwiftTradeExpressHTTPClient(
            base_url=args.base_url,
            api_key=args.api_key,
            api_secret=args.api_secret,
        )
        logger.info("Using RealSwiftTradeExpressHTTPClient.")

    trader = Trader(client=client, config=cfg, logger=logger)

    # Graceful shutdown handlers
    def handle_signal(signum, frame):
        logger.info(f"Received signal {signum}. Shutting down...")
        trader.stop()

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_signal)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_signal)

    try:
        trader.run()
    except ConfigurationError as ce:
        logger.error(f"Configuration error: {ce}")
        sys.exit(2)
    except APIRequestError as ae:
        logger.error(f"API error: {ae}")
        sys.exit(3)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Unexpected error: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    finally:
        logger.info("Exited gracefully.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Gautam Industries Product Fetcher

Description:
    Retrieves product details from a website's public WooCommerce Store API,
    focusing on laminate sheets and plywood boards, with emphasis on Greenlam
    and Merino laminate products as listed on Gautam Industries' website.

    This script:
      - Connects to a WordPress/WooCommerce Store API (no credentials required).
      - Paginates through results with retries and timeouts.
      - Filters by product types (laminate sheets and plywood boards).
      - Filters laminates by specific brands (Greenlam, Merino).
      - Exports results to JSON and/or CSV.

    Note:
      - Many WordPress e-commerce sites expose the WooCommerce Store API at:
            https://<base-url>/wp-json/wc/store/products
      - If the site uses WooCommerce but does not expose the Store API publicly,
        you may need API credentials for the WooCommerce REST API v3, or this script
        may not be able to access product data.

Usage:
    python gautam_products_fetcher.py \
        --base-url https://www.example.com \
        --out-json products.json \
        --out-csv products.csv \
        --brands Greenlam Merino \
        --product-types laminate plywood

Dependencies:
    - Python 3.9+
    - requests

    Install dependencies:
        pip install requests
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import logging
import sys
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlencode

import requests


# --------------------------- Configuration & Constants ---------------------------

DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S = 12.0
DEFAULT_RETRIES = 3
DEFAULT_BACKOFF_S = 1.25
DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 100

USER_AGENT = (
    "GautamIndustriesProductFetcher/1.0 (+https://example.com; contact=ops@example.com)"
)

# Keywords for product type detection (tune as needed)
LAMINATE_KEYWORDS = {
    "laminate",
    "laminates",
    "mica",
    "laminate sheet",
    "laminate sheets",
    "high pressure laminate",
    "hpl",
}

PLYWOOD_KEYWORDS = {
    "plywood",
    "ply wood",
    "ply board",
    "ply-board",
    "ply board",
    "ply",
    "blockboard",
    "board",
    "marine ply",
}


# --------------------------- Data Models ---------------------------

@dataclass
class ProductDetails:
    """Normalized product details model."""

    id: Optional[int]
    name: str
    brand: Optional[str]
    product_type: Optional[str]  # "laminate" or "plywood" (or None if unknown)
    sku: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]
    short_description: Optional[str]
    price: Optional[float]
    currency: Optional[str]
    in_stock: Optional[bool]
    categories: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    url: Optional[str] = None
    images: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    source: str = "wc_store_api"  # identify which source produced this entry
    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # raw API payload for traceability


# --------------------------- Utilities ---------------------------

def http_get_json(
    url: str,
    params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S,
    retries: int = DEFAULT_RETRIES,
    backoff_s: float = DEFAULT_BACKOFF_S,
) -> Any:
    """
    Perform an HTTP GET and decode JSON with retries and exponential backoff.

    Raises:
        requests.RequestException on repeated failure.

    Returns:
        Parsed JSON data.
    """
    headers = headers or {}
    headers.setdefault("Accept", "application/json")
    headers.setdefault("User-Agent", USER_AGENT)

    last_exc: Optional[Exception] = None

    for attempt in range(1, retries + 1):
        try:
            resp = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
            resp.raise_for_status()
            # Attempt JSON decoding
            return resp.json()
        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            last_exc = exc
            logging.warning(
                "GET %s failed on attempt %d/%d: %s",
                f"{url}?{urlencode(params or {})}",
                attempt,
                retries,
                str(exc),
            )
            if attempt < retries:
                # Exponential backoff with jitter
                sleep_s = backoff_s * (2 ** (attempt - 1))
                time.sleep(min(10.0, sleep_s))
            else:
                break

    assert last_exc is not None
    raise last_exc


def to_price_float(prices: Dict[str, Any]) -> (Optional[float], Optional[str]):
    """
    Convert WooCommerce Store API prices payload to price float and currency code.

    The Store API typically returns prices as strings in minor units and provides
    a currency minor unit to scale to major currency units.

    Example:
        prices = {
            "price": "149900",  # minor units
            "regular_price": "149900",
            "sale_price": "129900",
            "currency_code": "INR",
            "currency_minor_unit": 2
        }
    """
    if not isinstance(prices, dict):
        return None, None

    currency = prices.get("currency_code") or prices.get("currency") or None

    # Prefer sale_price, then price, then regular_price
    raw_val = (
        prices.get("sale_price")
        or prices.get("price")
        or prices.get("regular_price")
    )
    try:
        minor = int(raw_val)
        minor_unit = int(prices.get("currency_minor_unit", 2))
        return minor / (10 ** minor_unit), currency
    except Exception:
        # Fallback: try to parse as float string
        try:
            return float(raw_val), currency
        except Exception:
            return None, currency


def detect_product_type(
    name: str,
    categories: List[str],
    description: Optional[str],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Infer product type ("laminate" or "plywood") using keywords found in
    the name, categories, or description.
    """
    text_parts = [
        name.lower(),
        " ".join((c or "").lower() for c in categories),
        (description or "").lower(),
    ]
    haystack = " ".join(text_parts)

    if any(k in haystack for k in LAMINATE_KEYWORDS):
        return "laminate"
    if any(k in haystack for k in PLYWOOD_KEYWORDS):
        return "plywood"
    return None


def extract_brand(
    name: str,
    attributes: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    known_brands: List[str],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract brand from attributes or name.
    """
    # Inspect attributes (Store API: attributes -> list of { name, terms })
    for attr in attributes or []:
        attr_name = (attr.get("name") or "").strip().lower()
        # Store API typically uses attribute "pa_brand" or "brand"
        if attr_name in {"brand", "pa_brand"}:
            # terms in Store API could be strings or dicts with name property
            terms = attr.get("terms") or []
            if terms:
                # Normalize and choose the best matching brand
                values = []
                for t in terms:
                    if isinstance(t, dict):
                        values.append((t.get("name") or "").strip())
                    else:
                        values.append(str(t).strip())
                for v in values:
                    for kb in known_brands:
                        if v.lower() == kb.lower():
                            return kb
                # If exact match not found, return the first non-empty
                for v in values:
                    if v:
                        return v

    # Fallback: infer brand from name using known brands
    lname = name.lower()
    for kb in known_brands:
        if kb.lower() in lname:
            return kb

    return None


# --------------------------- Fetchers ---------------------------

def fetch_woocommerce_store_products(
    base_url: str,
    search_terms: List[str],
    per_page: int = DEFAULT_PER_PAGE,
    timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S,
    retries: int = DEFAULT_RETRIES,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Fetch products from WooCommerce Store API (public, read-only).

    It performs multiple searches (one for each term) and merges the results.
    Pagination is handled until an empty page is returned.

    Args:
        base_url: Website base URL, for example "https://www.gautamindustries.in"
        search_terms: List of search keywords, e.g., ["laminate", "plywood"]
        per_page: Items per page (max ~100)
        timeout: Request timeout in seconds
        retries: Number of retries per request

    Returns:
        List of raw Store API product objects (dict).
    """
    base_url = base_url.rstrip("/") + "/"
    endpoint = urljoin(base_url, "wp-json/wc/store/products")

    headers = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
    }

    seen_ids = set()
    all_products: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    for term in search_terms:
        page = 1
        while True:
            params = {
                "search": term,
                "page": page,
                "per_page": per_page,
            }

            try:
                data = http_get_json(
                    endpoint, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=timeout, retries=retries
                )
            except requests.RequestException as exc:
                logging.error("Failed to fetch Store API page %d for term '%s': %s", page, term, exc)
                break

            if not isinstance(data, list) or len(data) == 0:
                # No more results
                break

            added = 0
            for item in data:
                # Deduplicate by ID if present, else by permalink
                pid = item.get("id")
                key = pid if isinstance(pid, int) else item.get("permalink")
                if key in seen_ids:
                    continue
                seen_ids.add(key)
                all_products.append(item)
                added += 1

            logging.info(
                "Fetched %d items from Store API (term='%s', page=%d). Added %d new.",
                len(data),
                term,
                page,
                added,
            )

            page += 1

    return all_products


def normalize_store_product(
    product: Dict[str, Any],
    known_brands: List[str],
) -> ProductDetails:
    """
    Normalize a WooCommerce Store API product object into ProductDetails.
    """
    pid = product.get("id")
    name = product.get("name") or ""

    # Store API fields
    permalink = product.get("permalink")
    description = product.get("description") or None
    short_description = product.get("short_description") or None
    sku = product.get("sku") or None
    categories = [c.get("name") for c in (product.get("categories") or []) if c.get("name")]
    attributes = product.get("attributes") or []
    images = [img.get("src") for img in (product.get("images") or []) if img.get("src")]
    prices = product.get("prices") or {}
    price, currency = to_price_float(prices)
    in_stock = product.get("is_in_stock")

    brand = extract_brand(name=name, attributes=attributes, known_brands=known_brands)
    product_type = detect_product_type(name=name, categories=categories, description=description)

    return ProductDetails(
        id=pid if isinstance(pid, int) else None,
        name=name,
        brand=brand,
        product_type=product_type,
        sku=sku,
        description=description,
        short_description=short_description,
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
        in_stock=in_stock if isinstance(in_stock, bool) else None,
        categories=categories,
        url=permalink,
        images=images,
        source="wc_store_api",
        raw=product,
    )


# --------------------------- Filtering ---------------------------

def filter_products(
    products: List[ProductDetails],
    product_types: List[str],
    laminate_focus_brands: List[str],
) -> List[ProductDetails]:
    """
    Filter normalized products by:
      - Include only products whose product_type is in product_types (if specified).
      - For laminate products, include only those whose brand is in laminate_focus_brands (if specified).

    Args:
        products: List of normalized products.
        product_types: Target product types (e.g., ["laminate", "plywood"]). If empty, include all.
        laminate_focus_brands: For laminate products, restrict to these brands. If empty, include all laminate brands.

    Returns:
        Filtered list of ProductDetails.
    """
    ptypes = {pt.lower() for pt in product_types if pt}
    focus_brands = {b.lower() for b in laminate_focus_brands if b}

    results: List[ProductDetails] = []

    for p in products:
        # Product type filtering
        if ptypes:
            if not p.product_type or p.product_type.lower() not in ptypes:
                continue

        # For laminate products, focus on certain brands if provided
        if p.product_type and p.product_type.lower() == "laminate" and focus_brands:
            if not p.brand or p.brand.lower() not in focus_brands:
                continue

        results.append(p)

    return results


# --------------------------- Output ---------------------------

def export_to_json(products: List[ProductDetails], path: str) -> None:
    """
    Export products to JSON.
    """
    try:
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump([asdict(p) for p in products], f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        logging.info("Wrote %d products to JSON: %s", len(products), path)
    except Exception as exc:
        logging.error("Failed to write JSON file '%s': %s", path, exc)
        raise


def export_to_csv(products: List[ProductDetails], path: str) -> None:
    """
    Export products to CSV (selected fields).
    """
    fieldnames = [
        "id",
        "name",
        "brand",
        "product_type",
        "sku",
        "price",
        "currency",
        "in_stock",
        "url",
        "categories",
        "images",
        "description",
        "short_description",
        "source",
    ]

    try:
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)
            writer.writeheader()
            for p in products:
                writer.writerow(
                    {
                        "id": p.id,
                        "name": p.name,
                        "brand": p.brand,
                        "product_type": p.product_type,
                        "sku": p.sku,
                        "price": p.price,
                        "currency": p.currency,
                        "in_stock": p.in_stock,
                        "url": p.url,
                        "categories": "; ".join(p.categories),
                        "images": "; ".join(p.images),
                        "description": (p.description or "").strip(),
                        "short_description": (p.short_description or "").strip(),
                        "source": p.source,
                    }
                )
        logging.info("Wrote %d products to CSV: %s", len(products), path)
    except Exception as exc:
        logging.error("Failed to write CSV file '%s': %s", path, exc)
        raise


# --------------------------- CLI ---------------------------

def parse_args(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Fetch laminate sheets and plywood boards from a WooCommerce Store API, "
                    "focusing on Greenlam and Merino laminates."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--base-url",
        required=True,
        help="Base URL of the website (e.g., https://www.gautamindustries.in).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--brands",
        nargs="*",
        default=["Greenlam", "Merino"],
        help="Brand names to focus on for laminate products (default: Greenlam Merino).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--product-types",
        nargs="*",
        default=["laminate", "plywood"],
        help="Product types to include (default: laminate plywood).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out-json",
        default=None,
        help="Path to write JSON results (optional).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out-csv",
        default=None,
        help="Path to write CSV results (optional).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--timeout",
        type=float,
        default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S,
        help=f"HTTP timeout in seconds (default: {DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S}).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--retries",
        type=int,
        default=DEFAULT_RETRIES,
        help=f"HTTP retries per request (default: {DEFAULT_RETRIES}).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--per-page",
        type=int,
        default=DEFAULT_PER_PAGE,
        help=f"Items per page for Store API pagination (default: {DEFAULT_PER_PAGE}).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "-v",
        "--verbose",
        action="store_true",
        help="Enable verbose logging.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)

    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO,
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
    )

    # Ensure base URL is HTTPS if possible
    base_url = args.base_url.strip()
    if not base_url.startswith("http://") and not base_url.startswith("https://"):
        base_url = "https://" + base_url

    # The terms we search for via Store API
    search_terms = ["laminate", "plywood"]

    try:
        raw_products = fetch_woocommerce_store_products(
            base_url=base_url,
            search_terms=search_terms,
            per_page=args.per_page,
            timeout=args.timeout,
            retries=args.retries,
        )
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        logging.error("Error fetching products from Store API. Aborting. %s", exc)
        return 2

    if not raw_products:
        logging.warning(
            "No products returned by the Store API. The site may not expose the Store API publicly, "
            "or no matching products exist."
        )

    # Normalize
    normalized: List[ProductDetails] = [
        normalize_store_product(prod, known_brands=args.brands) for prod in raw_products
    ]

    # Filter
    filtered = filter_products(
        products=normalized,
        product_types=args.product_types,
        laminate_focus_brands=args.brands,
    )

    logging.info(
        "Normalized %d products, %d matched filters (types=%s, laminate-brands=%s).",
        len(normalized),
        len(filtered),
        ", ".join(args.product_types),
        ", ".join(args.brands),
    )

    # Output
    if args.out_json:
        export_to_json(filtered, args.out_json)
    if args.out_csv:
        export_to_csv(filtered, args.out_csv)

    # If no outputs specified, print a concise summary to stdout
    if not args.out_json and not args.out_csv:
        # Print a minimal JSON array to stdout
        print(json.dumps([asdict(p) for p in filtered], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logging.error("Interrupted by user.")
        sys.exit(130)

# ---------------------------- HTTP Client ------------------------------------


class APIClientError(Exception):
    """Base exception for API client errors."""


class APIRequestError(APIClientError):
    """Raised when an HTTP request fails or returns an error status."""


class APIResponseParseError(APIClientError):
    """Raised when the API response cannot be parsed as expected."""


class RateLimitError(APIRequestError):
    """Raised when rate limit is encountered and not recoverable."""


class TIDHClient:
    """
    TIDH API client with retry, timeout, pagination, and filtering support.

    This client is designed to be flexible, as actual endpoint schema may vary.
    Adjust ENDPOINT_PATH, query parameter names, and parsing to match TIDH docs.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        api_key: str,
        *,
        opportunities_path: str = DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITIES_PATH,
        timeout: float = 15.0,
        max_retries: int = 5,
        backoff_factor: float = 0.5,
        user_agent: Optional[str] = None,
        logger: Optional[logging.Logger] = None,
    ) -> None:
        if not base_url or not base_url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            raise ValueError("A valid base_url starting with http(s):// is required")
        if not api_key:
            raise ValueError("api_key is required")

        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.opportunities_path = opportunities_path if opportunities_path.startswith("/") else f"/{opportunities_path}"
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.logger = logger or logging.getLogger(self.__class__.__name__)
        self.user_agent = user_agent or "TIDHClient/1.0 (+https://your-company.example.com)"

        # Prepare a requests Session with retry strategy
        self.session = self._build_session(max_retries=max_retries, backoff_factor=backoff_factor)

    def _build_session(self, *, max_retries: int, backoff_factor: float) -> Session:
        session = requests.Session()
        retry = Retry(
            total=max_retries,
            read=max_retries,
            connect=max_retries,
            status=max_retries,
            backoff_factor=backoff_factor,
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
            allowed_methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"],
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            raise_on_status=False,
        )
        adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=10, pool_maxsize=10)
        session.mount("https://", adapter)
        session.mount("http://", adapter)

        # Default headers (customize to TIDH API requirements)
        session.headers.update(
            {
                "Accept": "application/json",
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
                "User-Agent": self.user_agent,
            }
        )
        return session

    def _request(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        *,
        params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        json_body: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute an HTTP request and return parsed JSON as dict.

        Raises APIRequestError or APIResponseParseError on failures.
        """
        url = f"{self.base_url}{path}"
        self._log_debug(f"Request: {method} {url} params={params}")
        try:
            resp: Response = self.session.request(
                method=method.upper(),
                url=url,
                params=params,
                json=json_body,
                timeout=self.timeout,
            )
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            raise APIRequestError(f"Request error: {e}") from e

        if resp.status_code == 429:
            # If retry adapter exhausted or Retry-After too long, raise a RateLimitError
            retry_after = resp.headers.get("Retry-After")
            message = f"Rate limited (429). Retry-After: {retry_after}"
            self._log_warning(message)
            raise RateLimitError(message)

        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            snippet = _safe_response_snippet(resp)
            raise APIRequestError(
                f"HTTP {resp.status_code} for {method} {url}: {snippet}"
            )

        try:
            data = resp.json()
        except ValueError as e:
            # Not JSON or invalid JSON
            snippet = _safe_response_snippet(resp)
            raise APIResponseParseError(f"Failed to parse JSON: {snippet}") from e

        return data

    def list_opportunities(

def _safe_response_snippet(resp: Response, limit: int = 512) -> str:
    """Return a safe response text snippet for error messages."""
    try:
        text = resp.text or ""
    except Exception:
        text = "<unavailable>"
    text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[:limit] + "..."
    return text


def _extract_list(data: Any, keys: List[str]) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
    """Extract a list from a JSON payload given multiple candidate keys."""
    if isinstance(data, list):
        return data
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None
    # Support dotted keys like 'data.items'
    for key in keys:
        value = _get_any(data, [key])
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return value
    # Sometimes items are nested one level deeper
    for key in keys:
        value = _get_any(data, [key])
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for _, v in value.items():
                if isinstance(v, list):
                    return v
    return None


def _normalize_next_path(next_link: str, base_url: str) -> str:
    """
    Convert 'next' into a path for the client's request method.
    Accepts absolute URLs, relative paths, or query-only forms.
    """
    next_link = next_link.strip()
    if not next_link:
        return ""
    # If already a path
    if next_link.startswith("/"):
        return next_link
    # If absolute URL
    if next_link.startswith("http://") or next_link.startswith("https://"):
        # Strip base_url if present
        if next_link.startswith(base_url):
            return next_link[len(base_url) :] or "/"
        # Else, return as-is but ensure it contains path (fallback)
        try:
            from urllib.parse import urlparse
            parsed = urlparse(next_link)
            path = parsed.path or "/"
            if parsed.query:
                return f"{path}?{parsed.query}"
            return path
        except Exception:
            return "/"
    # If query-only like "?page=2"
    if next_link.startswith("?"):

        return DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITIES_PATH + next_link
    # Fallback
    return "/" + next_link


def _get_any(d: Dict[str, Any], keys: Iterable[str]) -> Any:
    """Get the first available value for dotted keys from dict."""
    for key in keys:

        if value is not None:
            return value
    return None


def _get_str(d: Dict[str, Any], keys: Iterable[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    v = _get_any(d, keys)

    try:
        s = str(v)
        return s if s else None

def _get_float(d: Dict[str, Any], keys: Iterable[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    v = _get_any(d, keys)

    try:

def _get_int(d: Dict[str, Any], keys: Iterable[str]) -> Optional[int]:

    try:

def _deep_get(d: Dict[str, Any], dotted_key: str) -> Any:
    """
    Retrieve a nested value using dotted key notation, supporting both dot and slash.
    Example: "meta.total_pages" or "links/next"
    """
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        return None
    parts = []
    for token in dotted_key.replace("/", ".").split("."):
        token = token.strip()
        if token:
            parts.append(token)
    current: Any = d
    for p in parts:
        if isinstance(current, dict) and p in current:
            current = current[p]
        else:
            return None
    return current

def _parse_csv_pairs(s: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """
    Parse a string like 'a=1,b=2' into a dict {'a': '1', 'b': '2'}.
    Values are left as strings to preserve types; server will interpret.
    """
    result: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if not s:

    for part in s.split(","):
        if "=" in part:
            k, v = part.split("=", 1)
            k = k.strip()
            v = v.strip()
            if k:
                result[k] = v
    return result

        "opportunity_type",

    rows = []
    for o in opportunities:

                o.sub_sector or "",
                o.country or "",
                o.region or "",
                o.opportunity_type or "",
                f"{o.expected_irr:.2f}%" if o.expected_irr is not None else "",
                f"{o.min_investment:,.0f}" if o.min_investment is not None else "",
                o.currency or "",
                o.status or "",
                o.last_updated_at.isoformat() if o.last_updated_at else "",
            ]
        )

    # Compute column widths
    widths = [len(h) for h in headers]
    for row in rows:
        for i, cell in enumerate(row):
            widths[i] = max(widths[i], len(str(cell)))

    # Print header
    header_line = " | ".join(h.ljust(widths[i]) for i, h in enumerate(headers))
    sep_line = "-+-".join("-" * widths[i] for i in range(len(headers)))
    print(header_line)

    for row in rows:

                sleep_s = self.backoff_factor * (2 ** (attempt - 1))
                self.log.warning("Server error %s, retrying in %.2fs", resp.status_code, sleep_s)
                time.sleep(min(sleep_s, 10.0))
                continue

            # Non-success non-retry
            if not (200 <= resp.status_code < 300):
                raise APIRequestError(resp.status_code, f"Request failed: {resp.text}", _safe_json(resp))

            data = _safe_json(resp)
            self.log.debug("Response: %s", data)
            return data

# ----------------------------- Helpers ----------------------------- #

def _parse_retry_after(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[float]:
    """Parse Retry-After header value (seconds or HTTP date)."""
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        # Try seconds
        return float(value)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    try:
        # Try HTTP date
        parsed = dt.datetime.strptime(value, "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %Z")
        delta = parsed - dt.datetime.now(tz=dt.timezone.utc)
        return max(delta.total_seconds(), 0.0)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _safe_json(resp: requests.Response) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Safely parse JSON body, return empty dict on failure."""
    try:
        return resp.json() if resp.content else {}
    except ValueError:
        return {}


def _serialize(obj: Any) -> Any:
    """
    JSON serializer for dataclasses and datetimes.
    - Converts dataclasses to dict.
    - Converts datetime/date to ISO8601 string.
    """
    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(obj):
        return dataclasses.asdict(obj)
    if isinstance(obj, (dt.datetime, dt.date)):
        return obj.isoformat()
    return obj


def _print_json(data: Any) -> None:
    """Print JSON to stdout with deterministic formatting."""
    json.dump(data, sys.stdout, default=_serialize, indent=2, sort_keys=False)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()


# ----------------------------- CLI ----------------------------- #

def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Bronze Mining Investment Tracker CLI"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--base-url",
        default=os.getenv("BRONZE_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.example.com"),
        help="API base URL (default: env BRONZE_API_BASE_URL or https://api.example.com)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--api-key",
        default=os.getenv("BRONZE_API_KEY", ""),
        help="API key (default: env BRONZE_API_KEY)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--timeout",
        type=float,
        default=10.0,
        help="HTTP timeout in seconds (default: 10.0)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--retries",
        type=int,
        default=3,
        help="Max retries for transient errors (default: 3)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--backoff",
        type=float,
        default=0.7,
        help="Exponential backoff factor (default: 0.7)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "-v",
        "--verbose",
        action="count",
        default=0,
        help="Increase verbosity (-v, -vv)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mock",
        action="store_true",
        help="Use mock data instead of making real API calls",
    )

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    # portfolio
    p_port = subparsers.add_parser("portfolio", help="Get portfolio holdings for bronze mining sector")
    p_port.add_argument("--sector", default="bronze-mining", help="Sector filter (default: bronze-mining)")
    p_port.add_argument("--issuer", default=None, help="Issuer identifier (optional)")

    # esg
    p_esg = subparsers.add_parser("esg", help="Get ESG score for an issuer")
    p_esg.add_argument("--issuer", required=True, help="Issuer identifier")

    # costs
    p_costs = subparsers.add_parser("costs", help="Get cost metrics (AISC, cash costs, etc.)")
    p_costs.add_argument("--region", default=None, help="Region filter")
    p_costs.add_argument("--country", default=None, help="Country filter")

    # risks
    p_risks = subparsers.add_parser("risks", help="Get risk alerts")
    p_risks.add_argument("--severity", choices=["low", "medium", "high"], default=None, help="Severity filter")

    # projects
    p_projects = subparsers.add_parser("projects", help="Get bronze mining projects")
    p_projects.add_argument("--country", default=None, help="Country filter")
    p_projects.add_argument("--status", default=None, help="Project status filter")

    # hedges
    p_hedges = subparsers.add_parser("hedges", help="Get hedging positions for an issuer")
    p_hedges.add_argument("--issuer", required=True, help="Issuer identifier")

    # shipments
    p_ship = subparsers.add_parser("shipments", help="Get shipment volumes for a mine")
    p_ship.add_argument("--mine-id", required=True, help="Mine identifier")

    # performance
    p_perf = subparsers.add_parser("performance", help="Get performance metrics for an issuer")
    p_perf.add_argument("--issuer", required=True, help="Issuer identifier")
    p_perf.add_argument("--start", default=None, help="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    p_perf.add_argument("--end", default=None, help="End date (YYYY-MM-DD)")

    # insights
    p_insights = subparsers.add_parser("insights", help="Get market insights")
    p_insights.add_argument("--horizon", type=int, default=30, help="Horizon in days (default: 30)")

    return parser


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = build_arg_parser().parse_args(argv)
    setup_logging(args.verbose)

    # Construct API client
    try:
        client = BronzeInvestAPI(
            base_url=args.base_url,
            api_key=args.api_key,
            timeout=args.timeout,
            max_retries=args.retries,
            backoff_factor=args.backoff,
            mock=args.mock,
        )
    except ValueError as e:
        logging.getLogger("main").error("Configuration error: %s", e)
        return 2

    try:
        if args.command == "portfolio":
            holdings = client.get_portfolio(sector=args.sector, issuer=args.issuer)
            _print_json([h for h in holdings])
            return 0

        if args.command == "esg":
            esg = client.get_esg(issuer=args.issuer)
            _print_json(esg)
            return 0

        if args.command == "costs":
            costs = client.get_costs(region=args.region, country=args.country)
            _print_json(costs)
            return 0

        if args.command == "risks":
            risks = client.get_risks(severity=args.severity)
            _print_json([r for r in risks])
            return 0

        if args.command == "projects":
            projects = client.get_projects(country=args.country, status=args.status)
            _print_json([p for p in projects])
            return 0

        if args.command == "hedges":
            hedges = client.get_hedges(issuer=args.issuer)
            _print_json([h for h in hedges])
            return 0

        if args.command == "shipments":
            shipments = client.get_shipments(mine_id=args.mine_id)
            _print_json([s for s in shipments])
            return 0

        if args.command == "performance":
            perf = client.get_performance(issuer=args.issuer, start=args.start, end=args.end)
            _print_json([p for p in perf])
            return 0

        if args.command == "insights":
            insights = client.get_insights(horizon_days=args.horizon)
            _print_json(insights)
            return 0

        logging.getLogger("main").error("Unknown command: %s", args.command)
        return 2

    except APIClientError as e:
        # API or network error
        logging.getLogger("main").error("API error: %s", e)
        if isinstance(e, APIRequestError) and e.payload:
            logging.getLogger("main").debug("Error payload: %s", e.payload)
        return 1
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logging.getLogger("main").warning("Interrupted by user")
        return 130
    except Exception as e:
        logging.getLogger("main").exception("Unexpected error: %s", e)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
