#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Scrape and list all live TV channels from the Haiti Broadcasting website.

This script attempts to discover and extract live TV channel pages and (optionally) embedded stream URLs
from https://haitibroadcasting.com (or a custom base URL). It uses polite scraping practices:
- Custom User-Agent
- robots.txt compliance
- Rate limiting between requests
- Retry with backoff for transient errors

Output formats:
- JSON (default)
- CSV

Usage:
  python scrape_haiti_broadcasting.py
  python scrape_haiti_broadcasting.py --include-streams --format csv --output channels.csv
  python scrape_haiti_broadcasting.py --base-url https://www.haitibroadcasting.com/ --verbose

Dependencies:
  - requests
  - beautifulsoup4

Install:
  pip install requests beautifulsoup4
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import logging
import re
import sys
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from html import unescape
from typing import Iterable, List, Optional, Set, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse, urlunparse, urldefrag

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup, Tag
from requests import Response, Session
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib.robotparser import RobotFileParser
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry


# --------------------------- Configuration ---------------------------

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://haitibroadcasting.com/"
DEFAULT_DELAY_SECONDS = 1.0
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 12.0
DEFAULT_MAX_PAGES = 60
DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH = 2
DEFAULT_CONNECT_RETRIES = 3

USER_AGENT = (
    "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; HaitiBroadcastingScraper/1.0; "
    "+https://example.com/tools/haiti-broadcasting-scraper)"
)

# Seed paths likely to contain channels on the site; these are heuristics.
SEED_PATHS = [
    "",  # homepage
    "tv/",
    "television/",
    "live/",
    "live-tv/",
    "haiti-live-tv/",
    "channels/",
    "category/tv/",
    "category/television/",
    "tag/live/",
    "en/tv/",
    "fr/tv/",
]

# Terms that indicate pages likely listing TV channels
LIST_PAGE_TERMS = [
    "live tv",
    "television",
    "tv",
    "watch live",
    "channels",
    "chaînes",
    "chaine",
    "chèn",
    "chèn tv",
]

# Terms that may appear in channel names
CHANNEL_NAME_HINTS = [
    "tv",
    "tele",
    "télé",
    "télévision",
    "chaine",
    "chaîne",
    "chèn",
    "live",
]

# Ignore obvious non-content sections
EXCLUDE_SELECTORS = [
    "header",
    "footer",
    "nav",
    ".site-header",
    ".site-footer",
    ".navigation",
    ".menu",
    ".sidebar",
    ".widget",
    ".breadcrumbs",
    ".comments",
    ".related",
]


# --------------------------- Data Models ---------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Channel:
    name: str
    page_url: str
    stream_urls: Tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["stream_urls"] = list(self.stream_urls)
        return d


# --------------------------- Utilities ---------------------------

def setup_logging(verbose: bool) -> None:
    level = logging.DEBUG if verbose else logging.INFO
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=level,
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
    )


def build_session() -> Session:
    """Create a configured requests Session with retries and headers."""
    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers.update({"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9"})
    retry = Retry(
        total=DEFAULT_CONNECT_RETRIES,
        connect=DEFAULT_CONNECT_RETRIES,
        read=DEFAULT_CONNECT_RETRIES,
        backoff_factor=0.6,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset(["HEAD", "GET", "OPTIONS"]),
        raise_on_status=False,
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=10, pool_maxsize=10)
    session.mount("http://", adapter)
    session.mount("https://", adapter)
    return session


def normalize_base_url(url: str) -> str:
    """Ensure base URL has scheme and trailing slash."""
    if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        url = "https://" + url
    parts = urlparse(url)
    # Normalize netloc without trailing spaces, ensure path ends with slash
    netloc = parts.netloc.strip()
    path = parts.path if parts.path.endswith("/") or parts.path == "" else parts.path + "/"
    normalized = urlunparse((parts.scheme, netloc, path, "", "", ""))
    return normalized


def same_domain(url: str, base_netloc: str) -> bool:
    """Check if URL belongs to the same domain (ignoring leading 'www.')."""
    netloc = urlparse(url).netloc or base_netloc
    def strip_www(n: str) -> str:
        return n[4:] if n.lower().startswith("www.") else n.lower()
    return strip_www(netloc) == strip_www(base_netloc)


def clean_url(url: str) -> str:
    """Remove fragments and whitespace; keep query string as-is."""
    url, _ = urldefrag(url.strip())
    return url


def absolutize(base_url: str, href: str) -> str:
    return clean_url(urljoin(base_url, href))


def polite_get(session: Session, url: str, timeout: float, delay: float, rp: Optional[RobotFileParser]) -> Optional[Response]:
    """Fetch a URL with respect to robots.txt and delay."""
    if rp is not None and not rp.can_fetch(USER_AGENT, url):
        logging.debug("Blocked by robots.txt: %s", url)
        return None
    try:
        logging.debug("GET %s", url)
        resp = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
        # Respect delay after the request completes
        time.sleep(delay)
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            logging.warning("HTTP %s for %s", resp.status_code, url)
            return None
        return resp
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        logging.warning("Request failed: %s (%s)", url, e)
        return None


def load_robots(base_url: str, session: Session, timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT) -> Optional[RobotFileParser]:
    """Load robots.txt; return None if unavailable."""
    robots_url = urljoin(base_url, "robots.txt")
    rp = RobotFileParser()
    try:
        logging.debug("Fetching robots.txt: %s", robots_url)
        resp = session.get(robots_url, timeout=timeout)
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            logging.info("robots.txt not accessible (HTTP %s), proceeding cautiously.", resp.status_code)
            return None
        rp.parse(resp.text.splitlines())
        return rp
    except requests.RequestException:
        logging.info("robots.txt fetch failed, proceeding without it.")
        return None


def get_soup(html: str) -> BeautifulSoup:
    return BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")


def text_similarity_score(text: str, terms: Iterable[str]) -> int:
    """Count how many terms appear in text (case-insensitive)."""
    t = text.lower()
    return sum(1 for term in terms if term in t)


def find_main_content(soup: BeautifulSoup) -> Tag:
    """
    Try to identify the main content container to reduce noise.
    Fall back to body if not found.
    """
    candidates = [
        {"id": "main"},
        {"id": "primary"},
        {"role": "main"},
        {"class": "site-content"},
        {"class": "content"},
        {"id": "content"},
    ]
    for attrs in candidates:
        el = soup.find(attrs=attrs)
        if el:
            return el
    return soup.body or soup


def looks_like_list_page(url: str, soup: BeautifulSoup) -> bool:
    """Heuristic to detect a TV channels listing page."""
    title = (soup.title.string if soup.title else "") or ""
    headings = " ".join(h.get_text(separator=" ", strip=True) for h in soup.find_all(["h1", "h2", "h3"]))
    combined = f"{title} {headings}".lower()
    score = text_similarity_score(combined, LIST_PAGE_TERMS)

    # Boost score if many anchors look like channels
    anchor_texts = [a.get_text(" ", strip=True) for a in soup.find_all("a")]
    channel_like = sum(1 for t in anchor_texts if looks_like_channel_name(t))
    if channel_like >= 5:
        score += 2

    # Slight boost if URL path hints
    path = urlparse(url).path.lower()
    if any(seg in path for seg in ("tv", "tele", "live", "television", "channels")):
        score += 1

    return score >= 2


def looks_like_channel_name(text: str) -> bool:
    """Heuristic to decide if a string looks like a channel name."""
    if not text:
        return False
    t = unescape(text).strip()
    if not t or len(t) > 80:
        return False
    # Exclude generic nav/common words
    generic = {"home", "accueil", "about", "contact", "search", "menu", "news", "more", "categories"}
    if t.lower() in generic:
        return False
    # Must include at least some letters
    if not re.search(r"[A-Za-zÀ-ÿ]", t):
        return False
    # Include if hints appear or ends with TV
    t_low = t.lower()
    if any(h in t_low for h in CHANNEL_NAME_HINTS) or re.search(r"\btv\b", t_low) or t_low.endswith(" tv"):
        return True
    # Also allow known Haitian channel patterns (e.g., "Tele Caraibes", "Tele Ginen")
    if re.search(r"\btele\s+[a-z]", t_low):
        return True
    return False


def extract_links(soup: BeautifulSoup, base_url: str, base_netloc: str) -> Set[str]:
    """Extract internal links from a page."""
    links: Set[str] = set()
    for a in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
        href = a["href"]
        url = absolutize(base_url, href)
        if not same_domain(url, base_netloc):
            continue
        # Skip mailto/tel/javascript
        if url.startswith(("mailto:", "tel:", "javascript:", "about:")):
            continue
        links.add(url)
    return links


def filter_content_scope(soup: BeautifulSoup) -> BeautifulSoup:
    """Remove obvious non-content sections to reduce false positives."""
    filtered = BeautifulSoup(str(soup), "html.parser")
    for sel in EXCLUDE_SELECTORS:
        for el in filtered.select(sel):
            el.decompose()
    return filtered


def extract_channels_from_list_page(url: str, soup: BeautifulSoup, base_url: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """
    Extract channel candidates (name, page_url) from a page that is likely
    a listing of channels.
    """
    results: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    content = filter_content_scope(find_main_content(soup))

    # Prefer elements that look like card/grids
    containers = content.select(
        "[class*='channel'], [id*='channel'], [class*='grid'], [class*='list'], [class*='entry'], article"
    )
    if not containers:
        containers = [content]

    seen: Set[str] = set()
    for container in containers:
        anchors = container.find_all("a", href=True)
        for a in anchors:
            name = a.get_text(" ", strip=True) or ""
            if not looks_like_channel_name(name):
                # Try image alt/title as fallback for name
                img = a.find("img")
                alt_title = (img.get("alt") or img.get("title")) if img else None
                if alt_title and looks_like_channel_name(alt_title):
                    name = alt_title
                else:
                    continue
            page_url = absolutize(base_url, a["href"])
            if (name.lower(), page_url) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((name.lower(), page_url))
            results.append((name, page_url))
    return results


def extract_stream_urls(soup: BeautifulSoup, base_url: str) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
    """Extract possible embedded stream URLs from a channel page."""
    streams: Set[str] = set()

    # Iframes (YouTube, Dailymotion, JWPlayer, etc.)
    for iframe in soup.find_all("iframe", src=True):
        src = absolutize(base_url, iframe["src"])
        streams.add(src)

    # HTML5 video sources
    for video in soup.find_all("video"):
        if video.get("src"):
            streams.add(absolutize(base_url, video["src"]))
        for source in video.find_all("source", src=True):
            streams.add(absolutize(base_url, source["src"]))

    # Common lazy-load attributes
    for el in soup.find_all(attrs={"data-src": True}):
        ds = el.get("data-src")
        if ds:
            streams.add(absolutize(base_url, ds))

    # Filter to plausible streaming-related URLs while keeping generic embeds
    def plausible(u: str) -> bool:
        ul = u.lower()
        if any(x in ul for x in (".m3u8", ".mpd", "youtube.com", "youtu.be", "dailymotion.com", "twitch.tv", "player", "embed")):
            return True
        return False

    filtered = tuple(sorted(s for s in streams if plausible(s)))
    return filtered


def resolve_preferred_base(base_url: str, session: Session, timeout: float) -> str:
    """
    Try both base URL and www variant to pick a working base.
    """
    candidates = [normalize_base_url(base_url)]
    parsed = urlparse(candidates[0])
    if not parsed.netloc.lower().startswith("www."):
        with_www = urlunparse((parsed.scheme, "www." + parsed.netloc, parsed.path, "", "", ""))
        candidates.append(with_www)

    for cand in candidates:
        try:
            resp = session.get(cand, timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=True)
            if resp.status_code < 400:
                logging.info("Using base URL: %s", resp.url)
                return normalize_base_url(resp.url)
        except requests.RequestException:
            continue
    # Fall back to original
    logging.info("Proceeding with base URL: %s", candidates[0])
    return candidates[0]


# --------------------------- Scraper Core ---------------------------

def scrape_channels(
    base_url: str,
    include_streams: bool,
    max_pages: int,
    max_depth: int,
    delay: float,
    timeout: float,
    verbose: bool,
) -> List[Channel]:
    setup_logging(verbose)
    session = build_session()
    base_url = resolve_preferred_base(base_url, session, timeout)
    base_netloc = urlparse(base_url).netloc

    robots = load_robots(base_url, session, timeout)

    # Build initial queue of candidate pages to visit
    queue: List[Tuple[str, int]] = []
    seen_urls: Set[str] = set()

    def enqueue(u: str, depth: int = 0) -> None:
        u = clean_url(u)
        if u not in seen_urls and same_domain(u, base_netloc):
            seen_urls.add(u)
            queue.append((u, depth))

    # Seed likely pages
    for path in SEED_PATHS:
        enqueue(urljoin(base_url, path), depth=0)

    discovered_channels: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    visited_pages = 0

    while queue and visited_pages < max_pages:
        url, depth = queue.pop(0)
        if depth > max_depth:
            continue

        resp = polite_get(session, url, timeout, delay, robots)
        if not resp or "text/html" not in (resp.headers.get("Content-Type") or ""):
            continue

        visited_pages += 1
        soup = get_soup(resp.text)

        # If this page looks like a listing page, extract channels
        if looks_like_list_page(url, soup):
            logging.debug("List page detected: %s", url)
            ch = extract_channels_from_list_page(url, soup, base_url)
            if ch:
                discovered_channels.extend(ch)

        # Always crawl internal links up to max_depth to find more lists
        if depth < max_depth:
            links = extract_links(soup, base_url, base_netloc)
            for link in links:
                enqueue(link, depth + 1)

    # Deduplicate channels by normalized name and URL
    unique: dict[Tuple[str, str], Tuple[str, str]] = {}
    for name, page_url in discovered_channels:
        key = (name.strip().lower(), page_url)
        if key not in unique:
            unique[key] = (name.strip(), page_url)

    channels: List[Channel] = []
    for name, page_url in sorted(unique.values(), key=lambda x: x[0].lower()):
        streams: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
        if include_streams:
            resp = polite_get(session, page_url, timeout, delay, robots)
            if resp and "text/html" in (resp.headers.get("Content-Type") or ""):
                soup = get_soup(resp.text)
                streams = extract_stream_urls(soup, base_url)
        channels.append(Channel(name=name, page_url=page_url, stream_urls=streams))

    # As a fallback, if no channels were found, try a broader heuristic:
    if not channels:
        logging.info("No channels found via list pages. Attempting broad scan of homepage anchors.")
        resp = polite_get(session, base_url, timeout, delay, robots)
        if resp and "text/html" in (resp.headers.get("Content-Type") or ""):
            soup = get_soup(resp.text)
            anchors = soup.find_all("a", href=True)
            candidates: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
            for a in anchors:
                name = a.get_text(" ", strip=True)
                if looks_like_channel_name(name):
                    candidates.append((name, absolutize(base_url, a["href"])))
            # Dedup
            seen_c = set()
            for name, u in candidates:
                key = (name.lower(), u)
                if key in seen_c:
                    continue
                seen_c.add(key)
                streams: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
                if include_streams:
                    resp2 = polite_get(session, u, timeout, delay, robots)
                    if resp2 and "text/html" in (resp2.headers.get("Content-Type") or ""):
                        soup2 = get_soup(resp2.text)
                        streams = extract_stream_urls(soup2, base_url)
                channels.append(Channel(name=name, page_url=u, stream_urls=streams))

    return channels


# --------------------------- Output Helpers ---------------------------

def write_json(channels: List[Channel], output: Optional[str]) -> None:
    data = [c.to_dict() for c in channels]
    if output:
        with open(output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    else:
        json.dump(data, sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        sys.stdout.write("\n")


def write_csv(channels: List[Channel], output: Optional[str]) -> None:
    fieldnames = ["name", "page_url", "stream_urls"]
    if output:
        out = open(output, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        close_after = True
    else:
        out = sys.stdout
        close_after = False

    writer = csv.DictWriter(out, fieldnames=fieldnames)
    writer.writeheader()
    for c in channels:
        writer.writerow({
            "name": c.name,
            "page_url": c.page_url,
            "stream_urls": " | ".join(c.stream_urls),
        })

    if close_after:
        out.close()


# --------------------------- CLI ---------------------------

def parse_args(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Scrape and list all live TV channels from the Haiti Broadcasting website.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--base-url",
        default=DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        help="Base URL of the Haiti Broadcasting website.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--include-streams",
        action="store_true",
        help="Attempt to extract embedded player/stream URLs from channel pages.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-pages",
        type=int,
        default=DEFAULT_MAX_PAGES,
        help="Maximum number of pages to crawl.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--depth",
        type=int,
        default=DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH,
        help="Maximum crawl depth (0 = only seeds, 1 = follow links from seeds, etc.).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--delay",
        type=float,
        default=DEFAULT_DELAY_SECONDS,
        help="Delay in seconds between requests.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--timeout",
        type=float,
        default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
        help="Request timeout in seconds.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--format",
        choices=["json", "csv"],
        default="json",
        help="Output format.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        help="Output file path. Defaults to stdout if not provided.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--verbose",
        action="store_true",
        help="Enable verbose logging.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    try:
        channels = scrape_channels(
            base_url=args.base_url,
            include_streams=args.include_streams,
            max_pages=args.max_pages,
            max_depth=args.depth,
            delay=args.delay,
            timeout=args.timeout,
            verbose=args.verbose,
        )
        if args.format == "json":
            write_json(channels, args.output)
        else:
            write_csv(channels, args.output)

def parse_date(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[dt.date]:
    """Parse dates from common formats into a date object. Returns None if value is None."""

    """

    target = preferred.strip()

    for opt in select_el.options:

            select_el.select_by_visible_text(opt.text)
            return True
    # Case-insensitive contains text
    low = target.lower()

def _xpath_contains_ci(node: str, attr: str, keywords: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    """

    matching any of the provided keywords.
    """
    trans = "translate({node}, 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')"
    if attr == "text()":
        base = trans.format(node=f"{node}/text()")
    elif attr == "name()":
        base = trans.format(node=f"name({node})")
    else:
        base = trans.format(node=f"{node}/@{attr}")
    clauses = [f"contains({base}, '{kw.lower()}')" for kw in keywords]
    return "(" + " or ".join(clauses) + ")"

    # Fallback: any form
    with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutException):
        form = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.TAG_NAME, "form")))
        return form, "first form"
    return None


def find_link_to_booking(driver, timeout: int) -> Optional:
    """
    Try to discover a booking page link by anchor text or href.
    Returns element or None.
    """
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, timeout)
    patterns = ["book", "booking", "reserve", "reservation", "order", "jeep", "homestay", "tour"]
    expr = (
        "//a[" +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", patterns) +
        " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "href", patterns) +
        "]"
    )
    with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutException):
        el = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, expr)))
        return el
    return None


def find_input_field(driver, keywords: Sequence[str], timeout: int, types: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None):
    """
    Find an input or textarea associated with a label containing any of the keywords,
    or by name/id/placeholder containing a keyword.
    Optionally restrict to input types such as ['text','email','tel','date','number'].
    """
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, timeout)
    type_filter = ""
    if types:
        types_lc = [t.lower() for t in types]
        type_filter = " or ".join([f"translate(@type,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')='{t}'" for t in types_lc])
        type_filter = f" and ({type_filter})"

    # Match by label-for relationship
    label_expr = (
        "//label[" + _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", keywords) + "]/@for"
    )
    for_ids = driver.find_elements(By.XPATH, label_expr)
    for_id_values = [fid.get_attribute("value") for fid in for_ids if fid.get_attribute("value")]
    for for_id in for_id_values:
        el_expr = f"//*[@id='{for_id}']"
        try:
            el = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, el_expr)))
            if el.tag_name in ("input", "textarea", "select"):
                return el
        except TimeoutException:
            pass

    # Label wrapping input
    wrap_expr = (
        "//label[" + _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", keywords) + "]//input | //label[" +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", keywords) + "]//textarea | //label[" +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", keywords) + "]//select"
    )
    with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutException):
        el = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, wrap_expr)))
        return el

    # By attributes
    attr_expr = (
        "//input[" +
        "(" + _xpath_contains_ci(".", "name", keywords) + " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "id", keywords) + " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "placeholder", keywords) + ")" +
        f"{type_filter}" +
        "] | //textarea[" +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "name", keywords) + " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "id", keywords) + " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "placeholder", keywords) +
        "] | //select[" +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "name", keywords) + " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "id", keywords) + " or " +
        _xpath_contains_ci(".", "placeholder", keywords) +
        "]"
    )
    with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutException):
        el = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, attr_expr)))
        return el

    return None


def find_checkbox_or_radio_by_label(driver, keywords: Sequence[str], timeout: int):
    """
    Find a checkbox or radio input associated with a label containing any of keywords.
    Returns the input element or None.
    """
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, timeout)
    # Label with for attribute
    label_expr = "//label[" + _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", keywords) + "]"
    labels = driver.find_elements(By.XPATH, label_expr)
    for lbl in labels:
        for_attr = lbl.get_attribute("for")
        if for_attr:
            try:
                el = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.ID, for_attr)))
                input_type = (el.get_attribute("type") or "").lower()
                if input_type in ("checkbox", "radio"):
                    return el
            except TimeoutException:
                pass
        # Input inside label
        try:
            el = lbl.find_element(By.XPATH, ".//input[@type='checkbox' or @type='radio']")
            return el
        except NoSuchElementException:
            continue
    return None


def find_submit_button(driver, timeout: int):
    """
    Find a submit button by type or text.
    """
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, timeout)
    texts = ["book", "booking", "reserve", "reservation", "order", "send", "submit", "kirim", "pesan"]
    expr = (
        "//button[@type='submit' or " + _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", texts) + "] | " +
        "//input[@type='submit' or @type='button' or @type='image'] | " +
        "//a[" + _xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", texts) + "]"
    )
    with contextlib.suppress(TimeoutException):
        return wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, expr)))
    return None


# -----------------------------
# Booking workflow
# -----------------------------

def build_driver(headless: bool) -> webdriver.Chrome:
    """Initialize Chrome WebDriver with sensible defaults."""
    options = ChromeOptions()
    if headless:
        options.add_argument("--headless=new")
    options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
    options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
    options.add_argument("--disable-gpu")
    options.add_argument("--window-size=1280,900")
    options.add_argument("--lang=en-US")
    options.add_experimental_option("excludeSwitches", ["enable-automation"])
    options.add_experimental_option("useAutomationExtension", False)
    service = ChromeService(ChromeDriverManager().install())
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=service, options=options)
    driver.set_page_load_timeout(45)
    return driver


def navigate_to_booking_page(driver, cfg: ScriptConfig) -> None:
    """Navigate to the booking page, using a direct URL if provided or discovering via heuristics."""
    log = logging.getLogger("navigate")
    driver.get(cfg.base_url)
    human_delay()
    if cfg.booking_url:
        log.info("Navigating to booking URL: %s", cfg.booking_url)
        driver.get(cfg.booking_url)
        human_delay()
        return

    # Try to click a booking link
    link = find_link_to_booking(driver, cfg.timeout_sec)
    if link:
        try:
            link_text = (link.text or link.get_attribute("href") or "").strip()
            log.info("Following booking-related link: %s", link_text)
            driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:'center'});", link)
            try:
                link.click()
            except (ElementClickInterceptedException, ElementNotInteractableException):
                js_click(driver, link)
            human_delay()
            return
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("Failed to click booking link: %s", e)
    else:
        log.warning("No obvious booking link found on base page.")

    # Fallback: attempt common booking paths under the base URL
    common_paths = [
        "/booking", "/book", "/reserve", "/reservation", "/order",
        "/contact", "/contact-us", "/pesan", "/bromo-tour", "/jeep", "/homestay"
    ]
    from urllib.parse import urljoin
    for path in common_paths:
        url = urljoin(cfg.base_url.rstrip("/") + "/", path.lstrip("/"))
        log.info("Trying candidate booking URL: %s", url)
        try:
            driver.get(url)
            human_delay()
            maybe_form = find_form(driver, cfg.timeout_sec)
            if maybe_form:
                log.info("Found a form at %s", url)
                return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue

    log.info("Proceeding on the current page; will try to locate a form heuristically.")


def fill_booking_form(driver, cfg: ScriptConfig, details: BookingDetails) -> None:
    """
    Fill the booking form with provided details using heuristic field discovery.
    Raises TimeoutException or NoSuchElementException if form cannot be located.
    """
    log = logging.getLogger("fill_form")
    form_info = find_form(driver, cfg.timeout_sec)
    if not form_info:
        raise NoSuchElementException("Could not locate a booking/contact form on the page.")
    form, form_desc = form_info
    log.info("Using form located by: %s", form_desc)

    # Name
    name_el = find_input_field(driver, ["name", "your name", "nama"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["text"])
    if name_el:
        send_keys_safely(name_el, details.full_name)
        human_delay()
    else:
        log.warning("Name field not found; continuing.")

    # Email
    email_el = find_input_field(driver, ["email", "e-mail"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["email", "text"])
    if email_el:
        send_keys_safely(email_el, details.email)
        human_delay()
    else:
        log.warning("Email field not found; continuing.")

    # Phone / WhatsApp
    phone_el = find_input_field(driver, ["phone", "tel", "whatsapp", "wa", "no hp", "telepon"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["tel", "text", "number"])
    if phone_el:
        send_keys_safely(phone_el, details.phone)
        human_delay()
    else:
        log.warning("Phone/WhatsApp field not found; continuing.")

    # Number of people
    if details.num_people:
        ppl_el = find_input_field(driver, ["people", "persons", "pax", "guests", "orang"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["number", "text"])
        if ppl_el:
            tag = ppl_el.tag_name.lower()
            if tag == "select":
                Select(ppl_el).select_by_value(str(details.num_people))
            else:
                send_keys_safely(ppl_el, str(details.num_people))
            human_delay()
        else:
            log.info("People count field not found; will include in notes.")

    # Dates
    # Try a range (check-in/check-out) first if both provided
    if details.start_date and details.end_date:
        checkin_el = find_input_field(driver, ["check-in", "checkin", "start date", "arrival", "tanggal mulai", "tanggal datang"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["date", "text"])
        checkout_el = find_input_field(driver, ["check-out", "checkout", "end date", "departure", "tanggal selesai", "tanggal pulang"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["date", "text"])
        if checkin_el and checkout_el:
            set_date_field(checkin_el, details.start_date)
            human_delay()
            set_date_field(checkout_el, details.end_date)
            human_delay()
        else:
            # Try generic date range widget
            date_range_el = find_input_field(driver, ["date", "tanggal", "travel date", "stay date"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["text", "date"])
            if date_range_el:
                range_text = f"{format_date_for_text(details.start_date)} - {format_date_for_text(details.end_date)}"
                send_keys_safely(date_range_el, range_text)
                human_delay()
            else:
                log.info("Date range fields not found; will include in notes.")
    else:
        # Single date
        the_date = details.date or details.start_date
        if the_date:
            date_el = find_input_field(driver, ["date", "tanggal", "travel date", "tour date"], cfg.timeout_sec, types=["date", "text"])
            if date_el:
                set_date_field(date_el, the_date)
                human_delay()
            else:
                log.info("Single date field not found; will include in notes.")

    # Jeep rental option (checkbox/radio/select)
    if details.jeep_package:
        jeep_el = find_checkbox_or_radio_by_label(driver, ["jeep", "jeep tour", "bromo jeep"], cfg.timeout_sec)
        if jeep_el:
            try:
                if not jeep_el.is_selected():
                    try:
                        jeep_el.click()
                    except (ElementClickInterceptedException, ElementNotInteractableException):
                        js_click(driver, jeep_el)
                human_delay()
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("Failed to select Jeep option: %s", e)
        else:
            # Look for a select dropdown related to Jeep
            jeep_select = find_input_field(driver, ["jeep", "jeep package", "jeep tour"], cfg.timeout_sec)
            if jeep_select and jeep_select.tag_name.lower() == "select":
                if not select_dropdown_by_text_or_value(Select(jeep_select), details.jeep_package):
                    log.info("Could not match Jeep package in dropdown; will include in notes.")
            else:
                log.info("Jeep field not found; will include in notes.")

    # Homestay option (checkbox/radio/select)
    if details.homestay_preference:
        home_el = find_checkbox_or_radio_by_label(driver, ["homestay", "stay", "accomodation", "accommodation", "penginapan"], cfg.timeout_sec)
        if home_el:
            try:
                if not home_el.is_selected():
                    try:
                        home_el.click()
                    except (ElementClickInterceptedException, ElementNotInteractableException):
                        js_click(driver, home_el)
                human_delay()
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("Failed to select Homestay option: %s", e)
        else:
            home_select = find_input_field(driver, ["homestay", "room", "accommodation", "penginapan"], cfg.timeout_sec)
            if home_select and home_select.tag_name.lower() == "select":
                if not select_dropdown_by_text_or_value(Select(home_select), details.homestay_preference):
                    log.info("Could not match Homestay preference in dropdown; will include in notes.")
            else:
                log.info("Homestay field not found; will include in notes.")

    # Notes / message field
    message_el = find_input_field(driver, ["message", "note", "keterangan", "pesan", "additional info", "request"], cfg.timeout_sec)
    composed_note = compose_note(details)
    if message_el:
        send_keys_safely(message_el, composed_note)
        human_delay()
    else:
        log.warning("Message/Notes field not found; some details may not be included.")

    # Bring form to view for submission
    try:
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:'center'});", form)
    except JavascriptException:
        pass


def set_date_field(el, date_value: dt.date) -> None:
    """
    Try to set a date input field using multiple strategies:
    - If input type=date: send ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - Otherwise, try common human-readable formats
    """
    input_type = (el.get_attribute("type") or "").lower()
    if input_type == "date":
        send_keys_safely(el, date_value.isoformat())
        return
    # Try dd/mm/yyyy then yyyy-mm-dd then mm/dd/yyyy
    candidates = [
        date_value.strftime("%d/%m/%Y"),
        date_value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        date_value.strftime("%m/%d/%Y"),
        date_value.strftime("%d-%m-%Y"),
        date_value.strftime("%d %b %Y"),
    ]
    for val in candidates:
        try:
            send_keys_safely(el, val)
            return
        except Exception:
            continue
    # Final attempt
    send_keys_safely(el, date_value.isoformat())


def format_date_for_text(date_value: dt.date) -> str:
    """Format a date for free-text fields."""
    return date_value.strftime("%d %b %Y")


def compose_note(details: BookingDetails) -> str:
    """
    Compose a clear note string combining all relevant booking context.
    This ensures that if specific fields were not found, the information is still sent.
    """
    parts = []
    parts.append("Booking request for Mount Bromo.")
    if details.jeep_package:
        parts.append(f"Jeep: {details.jeep_package}.")
    else:
        parts.append("Jeep: Yes, please advise available packages.")
    if details.homestay_preference:
        parts.append(f"Homestay: {details.homestay_preference}.")
    else:
        parts.append("Homestay: Yes, please suggest options.")
    if details.num_people:
        parts.append(f"People: {details.num_people}.")
    if details.start_date and details.end_date:
        parts.append(f"Dates: {format_date_for_text(details.start_date)} to {format_date_for_text(details.end_date)}.")
    elif details.date or details.start_date:
        one = details.date or details.start_date
        parts.append(f"Date: {format_date_for_text(one)}.")
    if details.note:
        parts.append(f"Notes: {details.note}")
    return " ".join(parts)


def submit_form(driver, cfg: ScriptConfig) -> bool:
    """
    Attempt to submit the booking form. Returns True if a success indicator is detected,
    False otherwise. If confirm_submit is False, the function will not perform the final click.
    """
    log = logging.getLogger("submit")
    btn = find_submit_button(driver, cfg.timeout_sec)
    if not btn:
        raise NoSuchElementException("Could not find a submit/reserve/booking button.")

    if not cfg.confirm_submit:
        log.info("Dry-run mode: --confirm not provided. Skipping final submission click.")
        return False

    try:
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:'center'});", btn)
        human_delay()
        try:
            btn.click()
        except (ElementClickInterceptedException, ElementNotInteractableException):
            js_click(driver, btn)
        human_delay(0.6, 1.2)
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Failed to click submit: %s", e)
        return False

    # Wait for a success message or thank you page
    success_patterns = ["thank", "success", "terkirim", "berhasil", "sent", "confirmed", "dikirim"]
    expr = "//*[{}]".format(_xpath_contains_ci(".", "text()", success_patterns))
    try:
        WebDriverWait(driver, cfg.timeout_sec).until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, expr)))
        log.info("Detected a success/thank you message.")
        return True
    except TimeoutException:
        log.warning("No explicit success message detected. Check artifacts for confirmation.")
        return False


# -----------------------------
# Main entry point
# -----------------------------

def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Automate booking of a Jeep rental and homestay in Mount Bromo via a website (heuristic)."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", required=True, help="Base URL of Budi Bromo Tour's website (e.g., https://budibromotour.example).")
    parser.add_argument("--booking-url", help="Direct URL to the booking page/form (recommended).")
    parser.add_argument("--full-name", required=True, help="Your full name.")
    parser.add_argument("--email", required=True, help="Your email address.")
    parser.add_argument("--phone", required=True, help="Your phone/WhatsApp number.")
    parser.add_argument("--date", help="Single tour date (YYYY-MM-DD).")
    parser.add_argument("--start-date", help="Start/Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD).")
    parser.add_argument("--end-date", help="End/Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD).")
    parser.add_argument("--num-people", type=int, help="Number of people.")
    parser.add_argument("--jeep-package", help="Preferred Jeep package (e.g., 'Sunrise Jeep Tour').")
    parser.add_argument("--homestay-preference", help="Preferred homestay or requirements (e.g., 'Near Cemoro Lawang').")
    parser.add_argument("--note", help="Additional notes or requests.")
    parser.add_argument("--headless", action="store_true", help="Run browser in headless mode.")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=20, help="Explicit wait timeout in seconds (default: 20).")
    parser.add_argument("--confirm", action="store_true", help="Actually submit the booking (default: dry-run).")
    parser.add_argument("--log-level", default="INFO", help="Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).")

    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    setup_logging(args.log_level)

    # Validate inputs
    try:
        validate_email(args.email)
        validate_phone(args.phone)
        date = parse_date(args.date) if args.date else None
        start_date = parse_date(args.start_date) if args.start_date else None
        end_date = parse_date(args.end_date) if args.end_date else None

        if (start_date and not end_date) or (end_date and not start_date):
            raise ValueError("Both --start-date and --end-date must be provided for a range.")
        if not date and not start_date and not end_date:
            logging.getLogger("main").info("No dates provided; will include a generic request in notes.")

        details = BookingDetails(
            full_name=args.full_name.strip(),
            email=args.email.strip(),
            phone=args.phone.strip(),
            date=date,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
            num_people=args.num_people,
            jeep_package=args.jeep_package,
            homestay_preference=args.homestay_preference,
            note=args.note,
        )
        cfg = ScriptConfig(
            base_url=args.base_url.strip(),
            booking_url=args.booking_url.strip() if args.booking_url else None,
            timeout_sec=args.timeout,
            headless=args.headless,
            confirm_submit=args.confirm,
            artifacts_dir=Path("artifacts"),
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logging.getLogger("main").error("Invalid input: %s", e)
        return 2

    driver = None
    try:
        driver = build_driver(cfg.headless)
        navigate_to_booking_page(driver, cfg)
        fill_booking_form(driver, cfg, details)
        # Capture a pre-submit artifact for verification
        take_artifacts(driver, cfg.artifacts_dir, "before_submit")
        success = submit_form(driver, cfg)
        take_artifacts(driver, cfg.artifacts_dir, "after_submit")

        if success:
            logging.getLogger("main").info("Booking submission appears successful.")
            return 0
        else:
            logging.getLogger("main").warning("Booking submitted (or dry-run), but success could not be verified.")
            return 1 if cfg.confirm_submit else 0

    except (TimeoutException, NoSuchElementException) as e:
        logging.getLogger("main").error("Automation failed: %s", e)
        if driver:
            take_artifacts(driver, cfg.artifacts_dir, "error_state")
        return 3
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        logging.getLogger("main").exception("Unexpected error: %s", e)
        if driver:
            take_artifacts(driver, cfg.artifacts_dir, "unexpected_error")
        return 4
    finally:
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            if driver:
                driver.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

        self._assert_ok(resp, "Failed to create listing")
        return resp.json()

    # ---------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ---------------------------

    @staticmethod
    def _assert_ok(resp: requests.Response, msg: str) -> None:
        """
        Raise with details if response is not successful.
        """
        if 200 <= resp.status_code < 300:
            return
        try:
            data = resp.json()
        except Exception:
            data = {"text": resp.text}
        raise RuntimeError(f"{msg}: status={resp.status_code} body={json.dumps(data)[:1000]}")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# End-to-end Flow Functions
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def step_create_or_load_wallet(keystore_path: Path, password: str, private_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Wallet:
    """
    Step 1 (Code): Create or load a wallet.

    - If keystore exists, it will be loaded.
    - Else, if PRIVATE_KEY is provided, import it.
    - Else, generate a new wallet and save keystore.
    """
    wm = WalletManager(keystore_path=keystore_path, password=password)

    if wm.wallet_exists():
        wallet = wm.load_wallet()
        logger.info("Loaded wallet from keystore. Address=%s", wallet.checksum_address())
        return wallet

    if private_key:
        wallet = wm.import_from_private_key(private_key)
        logger.info("Imported wallet. Address=%s", wallet.checksum_address())
        return wallet

    wallet = wm.create_new_wallet()
    logger.info("Created new wallet. Address=%s", wallet.checksum_address())
    return wallet


def step_link_wallet_with_platform(client: CollectibleMarketHubClient, wallet: Wallet) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Step 3 (Code): Link your wallet with Collectible Market Hub by signing a challenge.
    """
    init = client.link_wallet_init(wallet.checksum_address())
    challenge_id = init["challengeId"]
    challenge_text = init["challenge"]

    signature = wallet.sign_text(challenge_text)
    link = client.link_wallet_complete(wallet.checksum_address(), challenge_id, signature)

    logger.info("Wallet linked. walletId=%s address=%s", link.get("walletId"), link.get("address"))
    return link


def step_upload_asset_and_metadata(
    client: CollectibleMarketHubClient,
    asset_path: Path,
    name: str,
    description: str,
    attributes: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Step 4 (Code): Upload your image and create metadata.
    - Detect MIME type
    - Request signed upload URL
    - Upload the file via PUT
    - Create metadata and return metadataUri
    """
    if not asset_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset not found: {asset_path}")

    content_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(asset_path.name)
    if not content_type:
        content_type = "application/octet-stream"

    upload = client.create_upload_url(file_name=asset_path.name, content_type=content_type)
    with asset_path.open("rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    client.put_upload(upload_url=upload["uploadUrl"], content_type=content_type, data=data)
    asset_url = upload["assetUrl"]

    meta = client.create_metadata(name=name, description=description, image_url=asset_url, attributes=attributes)
    metadata_uri = meta["metadataUri"]
    logger.info("Metadata created: %s", metadata_uri)
    return metadata_uri


def step_mint_nft(
    client: CollectibleMarketHubClient,
    wallet: Wallet,
    recipient: str,
    chain_id: int,
    metadata_uri: str,
    quantity: int = 1,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Step 5 (Code): Mint the NFT.
    - Create mint intent
    - Sign returned payload with your wallet
    - Confirm mint and obtain txHash and tokenId
    """
    intent = client.mint_intent(to=Web3.to_checksum_address(recipient), chain_id=chain_id, metadata_uri=metadata_uri, quantity=quantity)
    payload_to_sign = intent["payload"]
    signature = wallet.sign_text(payload_to_sign)
    result = client.mint_confirm(intent_id=intent["intentId"], signature=signature)
    logger.info("Mint submitted. txHash=%s tokenId=%s contract=%s", result.get("txHash"), result.get("tokenId"), result.get("contractAddress"))
    return result


def step_wait_for_confirmation(client: CollectibleMarketHubClient, tx_hash: str, timeout_sec: int = 180, poll_interval: float = 5.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Step 6 (Code): Optionally poll for on-chain confirmation via CMH API.
    """
    deadline = time.time() + timeout_sec
    last_status = None
    while time.time() < deadline:
        status = client.get_tx_status(tx_hash)
        last_status = status
        state = str(status.get("status", "")).lower()
        logger.info("Tx status: %s", state)
        if state in ("confirmed", "success", "finalized"):
            return status
        if state in ("failed", "reverted", "error"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Transaction failed: {status}")
        time.sleep(poll_interval)

    logger.warning("Timed out waiting for tx confirmation. Last status: %s", last_status)
    return last_status or {"txHash": tx_hash, "status": "unknown"}


def step_list_nft(
    client: CollectibleMarketHubClient,
    contract_address: str,
    token_id: int,
    chain_id: int,
    price: Decimal,
    currency: str = "ETH",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Step 7 (Code): List the newly minted NFT on Collectible Market Hub's marketplace.
    """
    listing = client.create_listing(
        contract_address=Web3.to_checksum_address(contract_address),
        token_id=token_id,
        chain_id=chain_id,
        price=price,
        currency=currency,
    )
    logger.info("Listing created: %s", listing)
    return listing


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Command-Line Interface (CLI)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_client_from_env() -> CollectibleMarketHubClient:
    """
    Create the API client using environment configuration.
    """
    base_url = os.environ.get("CMH_API_BASE_URL")
    api_key = os.environ.get("CMH_API_KEY")
    dry_run = env_bool("DRY_RUN", default=(not bool(base_url)))
    session = make_requests_session()
    client = CollectibleMarketHubClient(base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key, session=session, dry_run=dry_run)
    logger.info("CMH client configured. base_url=%s dry_run=%s", base_url or "None", client.dry_run)
    return client


def load_wallet_from_env() -> Wallet:
    """
    Helper to load or create a wallet using environment variables.
    """
    keystore_path_str = os.environ.get("WALLET_KEYSTORE_PATH", "./wallet.json")
    password = os.environ.get("WALLET_PASSWORD")
    private_key = os.environ.get("PRIVATE_KEY")

    if not password:
        raise ValueError("WALLET_PASSWORD environment variable is required to load/create wallet.")

    wallet = step_create_or_load_wallet(Path(keystore_path_str), password, private_key=private_key)
    logger.info("Wallet ready. Address=%s", wallet.checksum_address())
    return wallet


def cmd_create_wallet(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """
    CLI command: Create or import a wallet and save to keystore.
    """
    keystore = Path(args.keystore)
    password = args.password
    private_key = args.private_key

    wallet = step_create_or_load_wallet(keystore, password, private_key=private_key)
    logger.info("Wallet setup complete. Address=%s Keystore=%s", wallet.checksum_address(), keystore)


def cmd_link_wallet(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """
    CLI command: Link wallet to CMH by signing a challenge.
    """
    client = build_client_from_env()
    wallet = load_wallet_from_env()
    step_link_wallet_with_platform(client, wallet)


def cmd_create_nft(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """
    CLI command: Full flow - upload asset, create metadata, mint NFT, and optionally list it.
    """
    client = build_client_from_env()
    wallet = load_wallet_from_env()

    # Optional linking step (no-op if already linked server-side).
    try:
        step_link_wallet_with_platform(client, wallet)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("Wallet linking may have already been completed or failed in DRY_RUN: %s", e)

    # Step 4: Upload asset and create metadata
    metadata_uri = step_upload_asset_and_metadata(
        client=client,
        asset_path=Path(args.image),
        name=args.name,
        description=args.description,
        attributes={"creator": wallet.checksum_address(), "collection": args.collection} if args.collection else {"creator": wallet.checksum_address()},
    )

    # Step 5: Mint NFT
    chain_id = int(os.environ.get("DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID", args.chain_id))
    mint_result = step_mint_nft(
        client=client,
        wallet=wallet,
        recipient=wallet.checksum_address(),
        chain_id=chain_id,
        metadata_uri=metadata_uri,
        quantity=args.quantity,
    )

    tx_hash = mint_result.get("txHash")
    token_id = int(mint_result.get("tokenId"))
    contract_address = str(mint_result.get("contractAddress"))

    # Step 6: Optionally wait for confirmation
    if args.wait:
        step_wait_for_confirmation(client, tx_hash)

    # Step 7: Optionally list on marketplace
    if args.price is not None:
        currency = os.environ.get("MARKETPLACE_CURRENCY", args.currency)
        listing = step_list_nft(
            client=client,
            contract_address=contract_address,
            token_id=token_id,
            chain_id=chain_id,
            price=Decimal(str(args.price)),
            currency=currency,
        )
        logger.info("Listed NFT: %s", listing.get("url", listing))

    logger.info("NFT creation flow completed. tokenId=%s contract=%s txHash=%s", token_id, contract_address, tx_hash)


def make_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """
    Build argparse CLI with subcommands.
    """
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Collectible Market Hub - Wallet setup and NFT creation guide (with runnable examples)."
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    # create-wallet
    p_create_wallet = sub.add_parser("create-wallet", help="Create or import a wallet and save keystore.")
    p_create_wallet.add_argument("--keystore", required=True, help="Path to save the keystore JSON (e.g., ./wallet.json)")
    p_create_wallet.add_argument("--password", required=True, help="Password to encrypt the keystore")
    p_create_wallet.add_argument("--private-key", help="Optional hex private key to import")
    p_create_wallet.set_defaults(func=cmd_create_wallet)

    # link-wallet
    p_link = sub.add_parser("link-wallet", help="Link your wallet with Collectible Market Hub by signing a challenge.")
    p_link.set_defaults(func=cmd_link_wallet)

    # create-nft
    p_nft = sub.add_parser("create-nft", help="Upload an asset, create metadata, mint the NFT, and optionally list it.")
    p_nft.add_argument("--name", required=True, help="NFT name")
    p_nft.add_argument("--description", required=True, help="NFT description")
    p_nft.add_argument("--image", required=True, help="Path to image file (PNG, JPG, GIF, etc.)")
    p_nft.add_argument("--collection", help="Optional collection name attribute")
    p_nft.add_argument("--quantity", type=int, default=1, help="Quantity to mint (default: 1)")
    p_nft.add_argument("--chain-id", type=int, default=11155111, help="Chain ID (default: 11155111 for Sepolia)")
    p_nft.add_argument("--wait", action="store_true", help="Wait for tx confirmation")
    p_nft.add_argument("--price", type=float, help="List price (omit to skip listing)")
    p_nft.add_argument("--currency", default="ETH", help="Currency symbol for listing (default: ETH)")
    p_nft.set_defaults(func=cmd_create_nft)

    return parser


def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:
    """
    Entrypoint for CLI usage.
    """
    try:
        parser = make_parser()
        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
        args.func(args)
        return 0
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logger.error("Interrupted by user.")
        return 130
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("Error: %s", e)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""
Sunny Hurghada Property Scraper

This script scrapes property listings from the Sunny Hurghada website,
specifically filtering for properties located in "Makadi Bay" with 2 bedrooms.

Features:

- Command-line interface for configuration

        --csv-out makadi_bay_2br.csv
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import logging
import random
import re
import sys
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Iterable, List, Optional, Set
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse, urlunparse

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter, Retry
from urllib import robotparser


@dataclass
class PropertyItem:
    """Structured representation of a property listing."""
    url: str
    title: Optional[str]
    price: Optional[str]
    location: Optional[str]
    bedrooms: Optional[int]
    bathrooms: Optional[int]
    area: Optional[str]
    currency: Optional[str]
    description_snippet: Optional[str]
    images: List[str]
    collected_at: str


class SunnyHurghadaScraper:
    """
    A polite web scraper that crawls Sunny Hurghada property listing pages,
    extracts property URLs, and parses property details. It filters to properties
    in Makadi Bay with exactly 2 bedrooms.
    """

    DEFAULT_SEEDS = [
        "/",  # homepage fallback to discover links
        "/property/",
        "/properties/",
        "/for-sale/",
        "/for-rent/",
        "/en/property/",
        "/en/properties/",
        "/category/property/",
    ]

    # Heuristics to identify anchor tags that likely point to a property detail page
    PROPERTY_HREF_KEYWORDS = (
        "/property/",
        "/properties/",
        "property_id",
        "listing",
        "estate",
    )

    # CSS classes often used by WordPress real estate themes (heuristic)
    PROPERTY_CARD_CLASSES = (
        "property",
        "property-item",
        "property-card",
        "listing",
        "listing-item",
        "estate",
        "rh_list_card__wrap",
        "rh_prop_card",
        "houzez",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        user_agent: str,
        delay_seconds: float = 2.0,
        max_pages: int = 50,
        max_properties: int = 200,
        timeout: float = 20.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.base_url = self._normalize_base(base_url)
        self.delay_seconds = delay_seconds
        self.max_pages = max_pages
        self.max_properties = max_properties
        self.timeout = timeout

        self.session = self._build_session(user_agent=user_agent)
        self.robots = self._load_robots()

        self.visited_pages: Set[str] = set()
        self.found_property_urls: Set[str] = set()

        # Basic regexes reused in parsing
        self.re_bedrooms = re.compile(r"\b(\d+)\s*(?:bed(?:room)?s?|br)\b", re.I)
        self.re_bathrooms = re.compile(r"\b(\d+)\s*(?:bath(?:room)?s?|ba)\b", re.I)
        self.re_price = re.compile(
            r"(?:(USD|EUR|EGP|\$|€|£)\s*)?([\d\.,]+)\s*(USD|EUR|EGP|EGP\.)?",
            re.I,
        )
        self.re_area = re.compile(r"(\d[\d\.,]*)\s*(?:m²|sqm|sq\.?\s*m|m2|square\s*meters?)", re.I)

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_base(url: str) -> str:
        """Normalize base URL to scheme://host with trailing slash."""
        parsed = urlparse(url.strip())
        scheme = parsed.scheme or "https"
        netloc = parsed.netloc or parsed.path
        if not netloc:
            raise ValueError("Invalid base URL provided.")
        normalized = urlunparse((scheme, netloc, "/", "", "", ""))
        return normalized

    def _build_session(self, user_agent: str) -> requests.Session:
        """Create a configured requests session with retries and headers."""
        session = requests.Session()
        session.headers.update(
            {
                "User-Agent": user_agent,
                "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
                "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
                "Connection": "keep-alive",
            }
        )
        retries = Retry(
            total=5,
            backoff_factor=0.5,
            status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
            allowed_methods=("GET", "HEAD"),
            raise_on_status=False,
        )
        adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries, pool_connections=10, pool_maxsize=10)
        session.mount("http://", adapter)
        session.mount("https://", adapter)
        return session

    def _load_robots(self) -> robotparser.RobotFileParser:
        """Load and parse robots.txt to ensure polite crawling."""
        robots_url = urljoin(self.base_url, "/robots.txt")
        rp = robotparser.RobotFileParser()
        try:
            rp.set_url(robots_url)
            rp.read()
        except Exception as exc:
            logging.warning("Failed to read robots.txt at %s: %s", robots_url, exc)
        return rp

    def _is_allowed(self, url: str) -> bool:
        """Check robots.txt permission for the configured user-agent."""
        try:
            # The RobotFileParser uses the original UA string only for potential logging.
            # We accept disallow if parser cannot decide (e.g., robots missing).
            return self.robots.can_fetch(self.session.headers.get("User-Agent", "*"), url)
        except Exception:
            # Fail-safe: assume allowed if robots cannot be parsed
            return True

    def _throttle(self) -> None:
        """Respectful delay between requests with small jitter."""
        base = max(self.delay_seconds, 0.0)
        jitter = random.uniform(0, min(0.25 * base, 1.0))
        time.sleep(base + jitter)

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Fetch a URL with polite checks, returning raw HTML text or None on failure.
        """
        if not self._is_allowed(url):
            logging.info("Disallowed by robots.txt: %s", url)
            return None

        self._throttle()
        try:
            resp = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.timeout)
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            logging.warning("Request error for %s: %s", url, exc)
            return None

        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            logging.warning("HTTP %s for %s", resp.status_code, url)
            return None

        # Attempt to enforce correct encoding if none provided
        resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding or resp.encoding
        return resp.text

    def discover_listing_pages(self) -> List[str]:
        """
        Build an initial queue of listing pages to crawl.
        Strategy:
          - Test known seed paths commonly used by real estate themes
          - Extract additional listing-like pages from homepage if needed
        """
        seeds = [urljoin(self.base_url, path) for path in self.DEFAULT_SEEDS]
        discovered: List[str] = []

        for seed in seeds:
            html = self.fetch(seed)
            if not html:
                continue
            if self._page_has_property_cards(html) or self._page_has_property_links(html):
                discovered.append(seed)

            # Also try to discover additional listing pages via nav/menu links
            for link in self._extract_candidate_listing_links(html, current_url=seed):
                if link not in discovered:
                    discovered.append(link)

            # Be conservative: don't overload with too many seeds
            if len(discovered) >= 5:
                break

        # Ensure uniqueness and keep within the same origin
        unique_in_origin = []
        seen = set()
        base_netloc = urlparse(self.base_url).netloc
        for url in discovered:
            parsed = urlparse(url)
            if parsed.netloc == base_netloc and url not in seen:
                unique_in_origin.append(url)
                seen.add(url)

        if not unique_in_origin:
            logging.warning("No listing pages discovered; crawling homepage as fallback.")
            unique_in_origin = [self.base_url]

        return unique_in_origin

    def _page_has_property_cards(self, html: str) -> bool:
        """Heuristic: detect if the page contains property card elements."""
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
        for cls in self.PROPERTY_CARD_CLASSES:
            if soup.select(f".{cls}"):
                return True
        return False

    def _page_has_property_links(self, html: str) -> bool:
        """Heuristic: detect if the page contains anchors that look like property detail links."""
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
        for a in soup.select("a[href]"):
            href = a.get("href") or ""
            if any(k in href for k in self.PROPERTY_HREF_KEYWORDS):
                return True
        return False

    def _extract_candidate_listing_links(self, html: str, current_url: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        Extract candidate listing/archive pages from navigation menus or pagination.
        """
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
        candidates: Set[str] = set()

        # Common menu locations
        nav_selectors = [
            "nav a[href]",
            "header a[href]",
            ".menu a[href]",
            ".navigation a[href]",
            "a[href*='property']",
            "a[href*='properties']",
            "a[href*='for-sale']",
            "a[href*='for-rent']",
        ]
        for sel in nav_selectors:
            for a in soup.select(sel):
                href = a.get("href") or ""
                if not href:
                    continue
                abs_url = urljoin(current_url, href)
                if self._looks_like_listing(abs_url):
                    candidates.add(abs_url)

        # Pagination next links
        for a in soup.select("a[rel='next'], a.next, a.pagination-next"):
            href = a.get("href") or ""
            if href:
                candidates.add(urljoin(current_url, href))

        return list(candidates)

    def _looks_like_listing(self, url: str) -> bool:
        """Check if a URL looks like a property listing archive page."""
        u = url.lower()
        return any(
            kw in u
            for kw in (
                "/property/",
                "/properties/",
                "/for-sale/",
                "/for-rent/",
                "/category/property",
                "/listing",
                "/listings",
                "/estate",
                "/real-estate",
                "/page/",
            )
        )

    def extract_property_links_from_page(self, html: str, current_url: str) -> Set[str]:
        """
        Extract property detail URLs from a listing/archive page.
        """
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
        links: Set[str] = set()

        # 1) Obvious property links by keyword in href
        for a in soup.select("a[href]"):
            href = (a.get("href") or "").strip()
            if not href:
                continue
            abs_url = urljoin(current_url, href)
            if self._looks_like_property(abs_url):
                links.add(abs_url)

        # 2) Links from suspected property cards
        for cls in self.PROPERTY_CARD_CLASSES:
            for card in soup.select(f".{cls}"):
                for a in card.select("a[href]"):
                    href = (a.get("href") or "").strip()
                    abs_url = urljoin(current_url, href)
                    if self._looks_like_property(abs_url):
                        links.add(abs_url)

        return links

    def _looks_like_property(self, url: str) -> bool:
        """Check if a URL looks like a property detail page."""
        u = url.lower()
        # Heuristic: detail pages often contain '/property/' and not obvious pagination or categories
        if any(k in u for k in ("/property/", "/properties/")) and not any(
            k in u for k in ("/page/", "/category/", "/tag/")
        ):
            return True
        # Query parameter hints
        if any(k in u for k in ("property_id=", "listing=", "estate=")) and not any(
            k in u for k in ("page=", "paged=")
        ):
            return True
        return False

    def extract_pagination_links(self, html: str, current_url: str) -> Set[str]:
        """
        Extract pagination links from a listing page to continue crawling.
        """
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
        next_links: Set[str] = set()

        # Look for rel="next"
        for a in soup.select("a[rel='next']"):
            href = a.get("href") or ""
            if href:
                next_links.add(urljoin(current_url, href))

        # Look for common next/prev classes
        for a in soup.select("a.next, a.pagination-next, .pagination a"):
            href = a.get("href") or ""
            text = (a.get_text() or "").strip().lower()
            if "next" in text or "older" in text or "»" in text or ">" in text:
                if href:
                    next_links.add(urljoin(current_url, href))

        # Numeric pagination
        for a in soup.select("a[href*='/page/']"):
            href = a.get("href") or ""
            if href:
                next_links.add(urljoin(current_url, href))

        return next_links

        Uses multiple heuristics to locate title, price, bedrooms, etc.
        """

        # Title
        title = None
        for sel in ("h1", "h1.entry-title", "h1.page-title", "meta[property='og:title']"):
            node = soup.select_one(sel)

                if title:

        price_text = None
        currency = None
        price_candidates = [
            "span.price",
            ".property-price",
            ".rh_prop_card__price",
            ".price",
            ".amount",
            "[class*='price']",
